//============================================================
// Constructors

Valu::Valu(VerilatedContext* _vcontextp__, const char* _vcname__)
    : VerilatedModel{*_vcontextp__}
    , vlSymsp{new Valu__Syms(contextp(), _vcname__, this)}
    , clk{vlSymsp->TOP.clk}
    , rst{vlSymsp->TOP.rst}
    , op{vlSymsp->TOP.op}
    , c_in{vlSymsp->TOP.c_in}
    , nowrite{vlSymsp->TOP.nowrite}
    , z{vlSymsp->TOP.z}
    , n{vlSymsp->TOP.n}
    , c{vlSymsp->TOP.c}
    , v{vlSymsp->TOP.v}
    , a{vlSymsp->TOP.a}
    , b{vlSymsp->TOP.b}
    , res{vlSymsp->TOP.res}
    , mhi{vlSymsp->TOP.mhi}
    , rootp{&(vlSymsp->TOP)}
{
    // Register model with the context
    contextp()->addModel(this);
}

Valu::Valu(const char* _vcname__)
    : Valu(Verilated::threadContextp(), _vcname__)
{
}

}

std::unique_ptr<VerilatedTraceConfig> Vtb_top_wrapper::traceConfig() const {
    return std::unique_ptr<VerilatedTraceConfig>{new VerilatedTraceConfig{false, false, false}};
};

//============================================================
// Trace configuration

void Vtb_top_wrapper___024root__trace_decl_types(VerilatedVcd* tracep);

void Vtb_top_wrapper___024root__trace_init_top(Vtb_top_wrapper___024root* vlSelf, VerilatedVcd* tracep);

VL_ATTR_COLD static void trace_init(void* voidSelf, VerilatedVcd* tracep, uint32_t code) {
    // Callback from tracep->open()
    Vtb_top_wrapper___024root* const __restrict vlSelf VL_ATTR_UNUSED = static_cast<Vtb_top_wrapper___024root*>(voidSelf);
    Vtb_top_wrapper__Syms* const __restrict vlSymsp VL_ATTR_UNUSED = vlSelf->vlSymsp;
    if (!vlSymsp->_vm_contextp__->calcUnusedSigs()) {
        VL_FATAL_MT(__FILE__, __LINE__, __FILE__,
            "Turning on wave traces requires Verilated::traceEverOn(true) call before time 0.");
    }
    vlSymsp->__Vm_baseCode = code;
    tracep->pushPrefix(std::string{vlSymsp->name()}, VerilatedTracePrefixType::SCOPE_MODULE);
    Vtb_top_wrapper___024root__trace_decl_types(tracep);
    Vtb_top_wrapper___024root__trace_init_top(vlSelf, tracep);
    tracep->popPrefix();
}

VL_ATTR_COLD void Vtb_top_wrapper___024root__trace_register(Vtb_top_wrapper___024root* vlSelf, VerilatedVcd* tracep);

VL_ATTR_COLD void Vtb_top_wrapper::trace(VerilatedVcdC* tfp, int levels, int options) {
    if (tfp->isOpen()) {
        vl_fatal(__FILE__, __LINE__, __FILE__,"'Vtb_top_wrapper::trace()' shall not be called after 'VerilatedVcdC::open()'.");
    }
    if (false && levels && options) {}  // Prevent unused
    tfp->spTrace()->addModel(this);
    tfp->spTrace()->addInitCb(&trace_init, &(vlSymsp->TOP));
    Vtb_top_wrapper___024root__trace_register(&(vlSymsp->TOP), tfp->spTrace());
}

// === FILE: rtl/addr_packer.sv ===
`timescale 1ns/1ps
// Pixel index + page + fmt -> word address + pos.
// addr24 = (page << 16) | (word_offset << 1)
// word_offset = idx >> shift, pos = idx & mask
// fmt: 0=1bpp (shift 4), 2=4bpp (shift 2), 3=8bpp (shift 1),
//      4=16bpp (shift 0), 5/6/7=PASS (shift 0)
module addr_packer (
    input  logic [23:0] idx,       // pixel index inside the page
    input  logic [7:0]  page,      // high 8 bits of addr24
    input  logic [2:0]  fmt,
    output logic [23:0] addr24,
    output logic [3:0]  pos
);

    logic [2:0]  shift;
    logic [3:0]  mask;
    logic [23:0] word_offset;

    always_comb begin
        case (fmt)
            3'd0: begin shift = 3'd4; mask = 4'hF; end // 1 bpp
            3'd2: begin shift = 3'd2; mask = 4'h3; end // 4 bpp
            3'd3: begin shift = 3'd1; mask = 4'h1; end // 8 bpp
            default: begin shift = 3'd0; mask = 4'h0; end // 16bpp / PASS
        endcase

        word_offset = idx >> shift;
        addr24      = ({16'h0, page} << 16) | (word_offset << 1);
        pos         = idx[3:0] & mask;
    end

endmodule

// === FILE: rtl/alu.sv ===
`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// 16-bit ALU with class-based opcode (op[4:3]).
//   00 = logic:    op[2:1] = MOV/AND/OR/XOR, op[0] = inv
//   01 = arith:    op[2:1] = ADD/ADC/SUB/SBC, op[0] = sub
//   10 = shift:    op[2:1] = ROR/SHR/SAR
//   11 = other:    op[2:1] = MUL/RSV/TST/CMP
//   nowrite = op[2] (для logic/arith: не писать результат, только флаги)
//           = (fn != 00) для other (MUL пишет, TST/CMP нет)
//
// Flags: Z N C V. C = carry out (not borrow for SUB/SBC/CMP).
// MUL: signed 16x16 -> 32, low 16 to res, high 16 to mhi (registered).
module alu (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst,
    input  logic [4:0]  op,
    input  logic [15:0] a,
    input  logic [15:0] b,
    input  logic        c_in,        // для ADC/SBC
    output logic [15:0] res,
    output logic [15:0] mhi,         // старшие 16 бит последнего MUL
    output logic        nowrite,     // 1 = только флаги (CMP/TST)
    output logic        z,
    output logic        n,
    output logic        c,
    output logic        v
);

    // ===== decode =====
    logic [1:0] cls;
    logic [1:0] fn;
    logic       inv;
    logic       sub;
    logic       cin_sel;

    assign cls     = op[4:3];
    assign fn      = op[2:1];
    assign inv     = (cls == 2'b00) ? op[0] : 1'b0;
    assign sub = (cls == 2'b01) ? op[0] : (cls == 2'b11 && fn == 2'b11) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
    assign cin_sel = (cls == 2'b01) ? op[1] : 1'b0;

    // nowrite: для logic/arith — op[2]; для other — (fn != 00)
    assign nowrite = (cls == 2'b00 || cls == 2'b01) ? op[2] :
                     (cls == 2'b11) ? (fn != 2'b00) : 1'b0;

    // ===== operand B =====
    logic [15:0] b_x;
    assign b_x = b ^ {16{inv | sub}};

    // ===== сумматор =====
    logic        cin;
    logic [16:0] sum;
    assign cin = cin_sel ? c_in : (inv | sub);
    assign sum = {1'b0, a} + {1'b0, b_x} + {17'd0, cin};

    // ===== логика =====
    logic [15:0] logic_res;
    always_comb begin
        case (fn)
            2'b00: logic_res = b_x;       // MOV / MVN
            2'b01: logic_res = a & b_x;   // AND / BIC
            2'b10: logic_res = a | b_x;   // OR / ORN
            2'b11: logic_res = a ^ b_x;   // XOR / XNOR
        endcase
    end

    // ===== сдвигатель (mod 16) =====
    logic [3:0]  sh;
    logic        fill;
    logic [15:0] s0, s1, s2, s3;
    logic        is_ror;

    assign sh     = b[3:0];
    assign is_ror = (fn == 2'b00);
    assign fill   = (fn == 2'b10) & a[15];

    assign s0 = sh[0] ? {is_ror ? a[0] : fill, a[15:1]} : a;
    assign s1 = sh[1] ? {is_ror ? s0[1:0] : {2{fill}}, s0[15:2]} : s0;
    assign s2 = sh[2] ? {is_ror ? s1[3:0] : {4{fill}}, s1[15:4]} : s1;
    assign s3 = sh[3] ? {is_ror ? s2[7:0] : {8{fill}}, s2[15:8]} : s2;

    // ===== MUL (signed 16x16 -> 32) =====
    logic signed [15:0] a_s, b_s;
    logic signed [31:0] mul_p;
    assign a_s = a;
    assign b_s = b;
    assign mul_p = a_s * b_s;

    logic [15:0] mul_lo, mul_hi;
    assign mul_lo = mul_p[15:0];
    assign mul_hi = mul_p[31:16];

    // MHI регистр (защёлкивается на MUL)
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) mhi <= 16'h0;
        else if (cls == 2'b11 && fn == 2'b00) mhi <= mul_hi;
    end

    // ===== выбор результата =====
    always_comb begin
        res = a;
        case (cls)
            2'b00: res = logic_res;
            2'b01: res = sum[15:0];
            2'b10: res = s3;
            2'b11: res = (fn == 2'b00) ? mul_lo : a;
        endcase
    end

    // ===== флаги =====
    logic [15:0] flag_res;
    assign flag_res = (cls == 2'b11 && fn == 2'b10) ? (a & b_x) :   // TST
                      (cls == 2'b11 && fn == 2'b11) ? sum[15:0] :  // CMP
                      res;

    assign z = (flag_res == 16'h0);
    assign n = flag_res[15];
    assign c = (cls == 2'b01) ? sum[16] : (cls == 2'b11 && fn == 2'b11) ? sum[16] : 1'b0;

// === FILE: rtl/gpu_cache.sv ===
`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// gpu_cache: 4-entry cache (CH0..CH3), 3 EBR (TAG, DATA, PAGE).
// Wishbone master. page_we — тупой. access_done / flush_done — регистры (1 такт).
// FSM: C_IDLE -> C_FILL_REQ (wb_cyc_o держится до wb_ack_i) -> C_IDLE
//      C_IDLE -> C_WB_REQ   (wb_cyc_o держится до wb_ack_i) -> C_IDLE
module gpu_cache (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst,

    input  logic [1:0]  ch,

    input  logic [14:0] word_in,
    input  logic        access,
    input  logic        prefetch_req,

    input  logic        page_we,
    input  logic [7:0]  page_in,
    output logic [7:0]  page_out,
    input  logic        flush_en,
    input  logic [1:0]  flush_ch,
    output logic        flush_done,

    input  logic        we,
    input  logic [15:0] wdata,
    output logic        hit,
    output logic [15:0] rdata,
    output logic        access_done,

    output logic        wb_cyc_o,
    output logic        wb_stb_o,
    output logic        wb_we_o,
    output logic [23:0] wb_adr_o,
    output logic [15:0] wb_dat_o,
    input  logic        wb_ack_i,
    input  logic [15:0] wb_dat_i,

    output logic [23:0] addr24,
    output logic        error
);

    localparam int NCH = 4;

    logic [14:0] tag_ebr  [0:NCH-1];
    logic [15:0] data_ebr [0:NCH-1];
    logic [7:0]  page_ebr [0:NCH-1];
    logic        valid [0:NCH-1];
    logic        dirty [0:NCH-1];

    logic [14:0] cur_word;
    logic [7:0]  cur_page;
    assign cur_word = word_in;
    assign cur_page = page_ebr[ch];
    assign addr24   = {cur_page, cur_word, 1'b0};
    assign page_out = page_ebr[ch];

    always_comb begin
        hit   = valid[ch] && (tag_ebr[ch] == cur_word);
        rdata = data_ebr[ch];
    end

    // ===== FSM =====
    typedef enum logic [1:0] { C_IDLE, C_FILL_REQ, C_WB_REQ } cache_state_t;
    cache_state_t cstate;

    logic [1:0]  op_ch;
    logic [14:0] op_word;
    logic [7:0]  op_page;
    logic        op_we;
    logic [15:0] op_wdata;
    logic        op_is_access;
    logic        op_is_wb;

    // ===== выбор операции =====
    logic        start_fill, start_wb;
    logic [1:0]  start_ch;
    logic [14:0] start_word;
    logic [7:0]  start_page;
    logic        start_we;
    logic [15:0] start_wdata;
    logic        start_is_access;

    always_comb begin
        start_fill = 1'b0;
        start_wb   = 1'b0;
        start_ch   = 2'd0;
        start_word = 15'h0;
        start_page = 8'h0;
        start_we   = 1'b0;
        start_wdata = 16'h0;
        start_is_access = 1'b0;

        if (cstate == C_IDLE) begin
            if (access && !hit) begin
                start_fill = 1'b1;
                start_ch   = ch;
                start_word = cur_word;
                start_page = cur_page;
                start_we   = we;
                start_wdata = wdata;
                start_is_access = 1'b1;
            end else if (flush_req && valid[flush_ch] && dirty[flush_ch]) begin
                start_wb   = 1'b1;
                start_ch   = flush_ch;
                start_word = tag_ebr[flush_ch];
                start_page = page_ebr[flush_ch];
            end else if (prefetch_req && !hit) begin
                start_fill = 1'b1;
                start_ch   = ch;
                start_word = cur_word;
                start_page = cur_page;
                start_is_access = 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end

    // ===== Wishbone =====
    always_comb begin
        wb_cyc_o = 1'b0;
        wb_stb_o = 1'b0;
        wb_we_o  = 1'b0;
        wb_adr_o = 24'h0;
        wb_dat_o = 16'h0;

        case (cstate)
            C_FILL_REQ: begin
                wb_cyc_o = 1'b1;
                wb_stb_o = 1'b1;
                wb_we_o  = 1'b0;
                wb_adr_o = {op_page, op_word, 1'b0};
            end
            C_WB_REQ: begin
                wb_cyc_o = 1'b1;
                wb_stb_o = 1'b1;
                wb_we_o  = 1'b1;
                wb_adr_o = {op_page, op_word, 1'b0};
                wb_dat_o = data_ebr[op_ch];
            end
            default: ;
        endcase
    end

    // ===== access_done / flush_done (регистры) =====
    logic fill_done_c;
    assign fill_done_c = (cstate == C_FILL_REQ) && wb_ack_i && op_is_access && (ch == op_ch);

    logic access_done_r;
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) access_done_r <= 1'b0;
        else if (access && !hit && (ch != op_ch)) access_done_r <= 1'b0;
        else access_done_r <= access && (hit || fill_done_c);
    end
    assign access_done = access_done_r;

    logic flush_req;
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) flush_req <= 1'b0;
        else begin
            if (flush_en) flush_req <= 1'b1;
            if (flush_done) flush_req <= 1'b0;
        end
    end

    logic flush_pending;
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) flush_pending <= 1'b0;
        else begin
            if (flush_req && !flush_pending && cstate == C_IDLE) flush_pending <= 1'b1;
            if (flush_done) flush_pending <= 1'b0;
        end
    end

    logic flush_done_c;
    assign flush_done_c = (cstate == C_WB_REQ) && wb_ack_i && flush_pending && (op_ch == flush_ch);

    logic flush_done_r;
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) flush_done_r <= 1'b0;
        else     flush_done_r <= flush_done_c;
    end
    assign flush_done = flush_done_r;

    // ===== основная логика =====
    integer i;
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            for (i = 0; i < NCH; i++) begin
                tag_ebr[i]  <= 15'h0;
                data_ebr[i] <= 16'h0;
                page_ebr[i] <= 8'h0;
                valid[i]    <= 1'b0;
                dirty[i]    <= 1'b0;
            end
            cstate  <= C_IDLE;
            op_ch   <= 2'd0;
            op_word <= 15'h0;
            op_page <= 8'h0;
            op_we   <= 1'b0;
            op_wdata <= 16'h0;
            op_is_access <= 1'b0;
            op_is_wb <= 1'b0;
            error   <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            // page_we (тупой)
            if (page_we) begin
                page_ebr[ch] <= page_in;
                valid[ch]    <= 1'b0;
                dirty[ch]    <= 1'b0;
                tag_ebr[ch]  <= 15'h0;
            end

            // write on hit
            if (we && access && hit) begin
                data_ebr[ch] <= wdata;
                dirty[ch]    <= 1'b1;
            end

            // FSM
            case (cstate)
                C_IDLE: begin
                    if (start_fill) begin
                        op_ch   <= start_ch;
                        op_word <= start_word;
                        op_page <= start_page;
                        op_we   <= start_we;
                        op_wdata <= start_wdata;
                        op_is_access <= start_is_access;
                        op_is_wb <= 1'b0;
                        cstate  <= C_FILL_REQ;
                    end else if (start_wb) begin
                        op_ch   <= start_ch;
                        op_word <= start_word;
                        op_page <= start_page;
                        op_is_wb <= 1'b1;
                        op_is_access <= 1'b0;
                        cstate  <= C_WB_REQ;
                    end
                end

                C_FILL_REQ: begin
                    if (wb_ack_i) begin
                        tag_ebr[op_ch]  <= op_word;
                        data_ebr[op_ch] <= wb_dat_i;
                        valid[op_ch]    <= 1'b1;
                        if (op_we) begin
                            data_ebr[op_ch] <= op_wdata;
                            dirty[op_ch]    <= 1'b1;
                        end
                        cstate <= C_IDLE;
                    end
                end

                C_WB_REQ: begin
                    if (wb_ack_i) begin
                        dirty[op_ch] <= 1'b0;
                        if (flush_en && flush_ch == op_ch) valid[op_ch] <= 1'b0;
                        cstate <= C_IDLE;
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule

// === FILE: rtl/microcode_rom.sv ===
`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// 4096 x 32 microcode ROM, true dual-port BRAM.
// Port A: write (load microcode).
// Port B: read (PC -> instruction), 1-cycle latency.
module microcode_rom #(
    parameter int DEPTH     = 4096,
    parameter int ADDR_W    = 12,
    parameter int DATA_W    = 32,
    parameter     INIT_FILE = ""
) (
    input  logic              clk,
    input  logic [ADDR_W-1:0] addr,
    output logic [DATA_W-1:0] data,
    input  logic              we,
    input  logic [ADDR_W-1:0] waddr,
    input  logic [DATA_W-1:0] wdata
);

    (* no_rw_check *)
    logic [DATA_W-1:0] mem [0:DEPTH-1];

    initial begin
        if (INIT_FILE != "") $readmemh(INIT_FILE, mem);
        else for (int i = 0; i < DEPTH; i++) mem[i] = '0;
    end

    // Port A: write
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (we) mem[waddr] <= wdata;
    end

    // Port B: read, 1-cycle latency
    // (было: addr_r <= addr; data_r <= mem[addr_r]; — 2 такта)
    // (стало: data_r <= mem[addr]; — 1 такт)
    logic [DATA_W-1:0] data_r;
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        data_r <= mem[addr];
    end
    assign data = data_r;

endmodule

// === FILE: rtl/pixel_blender.sv ===
`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// pixel_blender: упаковка/распаковка пикселя + блендинг в 16-битное слово.
// Отдельный модуль от pixel_engine (по Q8).
//
// Чтение (read=1): word_in -> pixel_out (распакованный пиксель).
// Запись (read=0): word_in + pixel_in -> word_out (сблендённое слово).
//
// MODE:
//   0 = 1 bpp  (16 pixels/word) — только чтение
//   1 = 2 bpp  (8 pixels/word)  — только чтение (reserved)
//   2 = 4 bpp  (4 pixels/word)  — чтение и запись
//   3 = 8 bpp  (2 pixels/word)  — чтение и запись
//   4 = 16 bpp (1 pixel/word)   — чтение и запись (pass-through)
//   5 = PASS_LO8                 — низкий байт
//   6 = PASS_HI8                 — высокий байт
//   7 = PASS16                   — всё слово
module pixel_blender (
    input  logic        read,         // 1 = read (unpack), 0 = write (pack+blend)
    input  logic [2:0]  mode,
    input  logic [3:0]  pos,
    input  logic [15:0] word_in,
    input  logic [15:0] pixel_in,
    output logic [15:0] pixel_out,
    output logic [15:0] word_out
);

    logic [4:0]  shift;
    logic [15:0] mask;
    logic        is_16bit;
    logic        is_pass;

    always_comb begin
        shift  = 5'd0;
        mask   = 16'hFFFF;
        is_16bit = 1'b0;
        is_pass  = 1'b0;

        case (mode)
            3'd0: begin  // 1 bpp
                shift = 5'd15 - {1'b0, pos};
                mask  = 16'h0001 << shift;
            end
            3'd1: begin  // 2 bpp
                shift = ({1'b0, 3'd7} - {1'b0, pos[2:0]}) * 2;
                mask  = 16'h0003 << shift;
            end
            3'd2: begin  // 4 bpp
                shift = ({1'b0, 2'd3} - {1'b0, pos[1:0]}) * 4;
                mask  = 16'h000F << shift;
            end
            3'd3: begin  // 8 bpp
                shift = ({1'b0, 1'b1} - {1'b0, pos[0]}) * 8;
                mask  = 16'h00FF << shift;
            end
            3'd4: begin  // 16 bpp
                shift = 5'd0;
                mask  = 16'hFFFF;
                is_16bit = 1'b1;
            end
            3'd5: begin  // PASS_LO8
                shift = 5'd0;
                mask  = 16'h00FF;
                is_pass = 1'b1;
            end
            3'd6: begin  // PASS_HI8
                shift = 5'd8;
                mask  = 16'hFF00;
                is_pass = 1'b1;
            end
            3'd7: begin  // PASS16
                shift = 5'd0;
                mask  = 16'hFFFF;
                is_pass = 1'b1;
                is_16bit = 1'b1;
            end
        endcase
    end

    // ===== чтение: распаковка =====
    always_comb begin
        if (is_16bit)
            pixel_out = word_in;
        else if (is_pass)
            pixel_out = {8'h0, (word_in & mask) >> shift};
        else
            pixel_out = {12'h0, (word_in & mask) >> shift};
    end

    // ===== запись: блендинг =====
    logic write_allowed;
    always_comb begin
        write_allowed = 1'b1;
        if (mode == 3'd0 || mode == 3'd1) write_allowed = 1'b0;
    end

    always_comb begin
        if (!write_allowed)
            word_out = word_in;
        else if (is_16bit)
            word_out = pixel_in;
        else
            word_out = (word_in & ~mask) | ((pixel_in << shift) & mask);
    end

endmodule

// === FILE: rtl/pixel_engine.sv ===
`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

module pixel_engine (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst,

    input  logic [1:0]  ch,

    input  logic        mode_we,
    input  logic [2:0]  mode_in,
    input  logic        idxh_we,
    input  logic [2:0]  idxh_in,
    input  logic        idx_we,
    input  logic [15:0] idx_in,
    input  logic        step_we,
    input  logic [15:0] step_in,

    input  logic        access,
    output logic [14:0] word_out,
    output logic [3:0]  pos,
    output logic [2:0]  mode,
    output logic        prefetch_req
);

    localparam int NCH = 4;

    // EBR: 8 записей × 19 бит (IDX/STEP, 4 канала × 2)
    logic [18:0] idx_step_mem [0:7];
    logic [18:0] idx_stored, step_stored;

    logic [2:0]  mode_r [0:NCH-1];
    logic [2:0]  idxh_r [0:NCH-1];

    function automatic logic [2:0] k_of_fmt(input logic [2:0] fmt);
        case (fmt)
            3'd0: k_of_fmt = 3'd4;  // 1 bpp
            3'd1: k_of_fmt = 3'd3;  // 2 bpp
            3'd2: k_of_fmt = 3'd2;  // 4 bpp
            3'd3: k_of_fmt = 3'd1;  // 8 bpp
            3'd4: k_of_fmt = 3'd0;  // 16 bpp
            default: k_of_fmt = 3'd0; // PASS_*
        endcase
    endfunction

    logic [2:0]  k;
    logic [3:0]  shift_left;
    assign k          = k_of_fmt(mode_r[ch]);
    assign shift_left = 4 - k;

    assign idx_stored  = idx_step_mem[{ch, 1'b0}];
    assign step_stored = idx_step_mem[{ch, 1'b1}];

    // word_out = целая часть (15 бит), pos = дробная часть >> shift_left
    assign word_out = idx_stored[18:4];
    assign pos      = idx_stored[3:0] >> shift_left;
    assign mode     = mode_r[ch];

    // Запись IDX: value = {idxh_r[ch], idx_in} = 19 целых.
    // stored = (value << 4) >> k, обрезаем до 19 бит.
    logic [22:0] idx_shifted;
    assign idx_shifted   = {idxh_r[ch], idx_in, 4'b0} >> k;
    logic [18:0] idx_write_val;
    assign idx_write_val = idx_shifted[18:0];

    // Запись STEP: 12.4 (16 бит знаковый) -> 15.4 (19 бит), расширение знаком.
    logic [18:0] step_write_val;
    assign step_write_val = {{3{step_in[15]}}, step_in} >> k;

    // EBR: запись при IDX/STEP или автоинкремент
    logic [18:0] idx_next;
    assign idx_next = idx_stored + step_stored;

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (idx_we)       begin 
             $display("IDX write: ch=%d mode=%d k=%d idx_in=%h write_val=%h",
                 ch, mode_r[ch], k, idx_in, idx_write_val);
            idx_step_mem[{ch, 1'b0}] <= idx_write_val;
            end
        else if (access)  idx_step_mem[{ch, 1'b0}] <= idx_next;
        if (step_we)      idx_step_mem[{ch, 1'b1}] <= step_write_val;
    end

    // MODE регистры
    integer i;
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            for (i = 0; i < NCH; i++) mode_r[i] <= 3'd0;
        end else if (mode_we) begin
            mode_r[ch] <= mode_in;
        end
    end

    // IDXH регистры (на канал, обнуляется после IDX)
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            for (i = 0; i < NCH; i++) idxh_r[i] <= 3'h0;
        end else begin
            for (i = 0; i < NCH; i++) begin
                if (idxh_we && ch == i[1:0])    idxh_r[i] <= idxh_in;
                else if (idx_we && ch == i[1:0]) idxh_r[i] <= 3'h0;
            end
        end
    end

    // prefetch
    logic [14:0] word_prev;
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) word_prev <= 15'h0;
        else     word_prev <= word_out;
    end

    logic idx_we_d;
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) idx_we_d <= 1'b0;
        else     idx_we_d <= idx_we;
    end
    assign prefetch_req = idx_we_d || (access && (word_out != word_prev));

endmodule

// === FILE: rtl/regfile.sv ===
`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// 32 x 24, 2 read ports, 1 write port. Two EBR copies, both written.
// Synchronous read (latency 1). Write-through bypass: если читается адрес,
// записываемый в этом же такте, на выход идёт новое значение.
module regfile (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst,        // не используется: EBR не сбрасывается
    input  logic [4:0]  ra,
    output logic [23:0] rdata_a,
    input  logic [4:0]  rb,
    output logic [23:0] rdata_b,
    input  logic        we,
    input  logic [4:0]  wa,
    input  logic [23:0] wdata
);

    (* ram_style = "block", no_rw_check *) logic [23:0] mem_a [0:31];
    (* ram_style = "block", no_rw_check *) logic [23:0] mem_b [0:31];

    logic [23:0] q_a, q_b;
    logic        byp_a, byp_b;
    logic [23:0] wdata_r;

    initial begin
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) begin
            mem_a[i] = '0;
            mem_b[i] = '0;
        end
    end

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (we) begin
            mem_a[wa] <= wdata;
            mem_b[wa] <= wdata;
        end
        q_a     <= mem_a[ra];
        q_b     <= mem_b[rb];
        byp_a   <= we && (wa == ra);
        byp_b   <= we && (wa == rb);
        wdata_r <= wdata;
    end

    assign rdata_a = byp_a ? wdata_r : q_a;
    assign rdata_b = byp_b ? wdata_r : q_b;

endmodule

// === FILE: rtl/sequencer.sv ===
`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// Program counter, SHADOW, LOOP.CNT/TGT, flags, next-PC selection.
// One instruction per cycle (model). Ports may stall the sequencer.
//
// Priority for next PC:
//   1. HALT (stops, PC not updated)
//   2. Taken JMP / CALL / RET / JMPR (L ignored, CNT not decremented)
//   3. L with CNT > 1 (PC = LOOP.TGT, CNT--)
//   4. PC + 1
//
// L is allowed on any class. A taken branch overrides L.
// CALL writes SHADOW = {flags[3:0], PC+1[11:0]}.
// RET uses SHADOW[11:0] only (flags not restored).
// JMPR uses operand REG[11:0].
// start resets PC, ERROR, error_code.
module sequencer (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst,

    // instruction fields
    input  logic [1:0]  imm_class,   // {J, I}: 00=reg-reg, 01=LDI (unused), 10=ctrl, 11=reg-imm12
    input  logic [4:0]  reg_op,      // ALU op or CTRL op
    input  logic [3:0]  cond,
    input  logic        l,           // loop flag
    input  logic [11:0] imm12,       // ADDR / IMM12

    // current flags
    input  logic        z, n, c, v,

    // from ALU
    input  logic [11:0] jmpr_target, // operand[REG][11:0] for JMPR

    // outputs
    output logic [11:0] pc,
    output logic [11:0] pc_next,
    output logic [15:0] shadow,
    output logic [15:0] loop_cnt,    // CNT (16 bits)
    output logic [11:0] loop_tgt,    // TGT (12 bits)
    output logic        halted,
    output logic        error,
    output logic [11:0] error_code,
    output logic        irq_pending,
    output logic [11:0] irq_code,

    input  logic        start,
    input  logic        stall,

    // test-only: write LOOP.CNT / LOOP.TGT
    input  logic        loop_cnt_we,
    input  logic [15:0] loop_cnt_in,
    input  logic        loop_tgt_we,
    input  logic [11:0] loop_tgt_in
);

    // ===== condition decode =====
    function automatic logic cond_true(input logic [3:0] cd,
                                       input logic zz, nn, cc, vv);
        case (cd)
            4'd0:  cond_true = 1'b1;                       // AL
            4'd1:  cond_true = zz;                         // EQ
            4'd2:  cond_true = ~zz;                        // NE
            4'd3:  cond_true = cc;                         // CS
            4'd4:  cond_true = ~cc;                        // CC
            4'd5:  cond_true = nn;                         // MI
            4'd6:  cond_true = ~nn;                        // PL
            4'd7:  cond_true = vv;                         // VS
            4'd8:  cond_true = ~vv;                        // VC
            4'd9:  cond_true = cc & ~zz;                   // HI
            4'd10: cond_true = ~cc | zz;                   // LS
            4'd11: cond_true = (nn == vv);                 // GE
            4'd12: cond_true = (nn != vv);                 // LT
            4'd13: cond_true = ~zz & (nn == vv);           // GT
            4'd14: cond_true = zz | (nn != vv);            // LE
            default: cond_true = 1'b0;
        endcase
    endfunction

    // ===== CTRL op codes =====
    // Используем `define, а не localparam: Verilator не поддерживает
    // localparam с тем же именем, что и метка case.
    `define OP_NOP   5'd0
    `define OP_JMP   5'd1
    `define OP_CALL  5'd2
    `define OP_RET   5'd3
    `define OP_JMPR  5'd4
    `define OP_HALT  5'd5
    `define OP_IRQ   5'd6
    `define OP_FLUSH 5'd7

    logic is_ctrl;
    logic active;
    logic do_ctrl;
    logic taken_branch;
    logic [11:0] pc_next_c;

    assign is_ctrl = (imm_class == 2'b10);
    assign active  = cond_true(cond, z, n, c, v);
    assign do_ctrl = is_ctrl && active;

    // taken_branch: JMP/CALL/RET/JMPR, taken
    always_comb begin
        taken_branch = 1'b0;
        if (do_ctrl) begin
            case (reg_op)
                `OP_JMP, `OP_CALL, `OP_RET, `OP_JMPR: taken_branch = 1'b1;
                default: taken_branch = 1'b0;
            endcase
        end
    end

    // ===== combinational next-PC =====
    always_comb begin
        pc_next_c = pc + 12'd1;

        // 1. taken branch overrides everything (L ignored)
        if (taken_branch) begin
            case (reg_op)
                `OP_JMP, `OP_CALL: pc_next_c = imm12;
                `OP_RET:           pc_next_c = shadow[11:0];
                `OP_JMPR:          pc_next_c = jmpr_target;
                default:           pc_next_c = pc + 12'd1;
            endcase
        end
        // 2. L with CNT > 1 (only if no taken branch)
        else if (l && (loop_cnt > 16'd1)) begin
            pc_next_c = loop_tgt;
        end
        // 3. PC + 1 (default)
    end

    assign pc_next = pc_next_c;

    // ===== state =====
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            pc          <= 12'h0;
            shadow      <= 16'h0;
            loop_cnt    <= 16'h0;
            loop_tgt    <= 12'h0;
            halted      <= 1'b1;
            error       <= 1'b0;
            error_code  <= 12'h0;
            irq_pending <= 1'b0;
            irq_code    <= 12'h0;
        end else if (start) begin
            pc          <= 12'h0;
            halted      <= 1'b0;
            error       <= 1'b0;
            error_code  <= 12'h0;
            irq_pending <= 1'b0;
            irq_code    <= 12'h0;
        end else if (halted || error || stall) begin
            // stay put
        end else begin
            pc <= pc_next_c;

            // LOOP.CNT / LOOP.TGT update (test-only, via ports)
            if (loop_cnt_we) loop_cnt <= loop_cnt_in;
            else if (l && !taken_branch && (loop_cnt > 16'd1))
                loop_cnt <= loop_cnt - 16'd1;
            if (loop_tgt_we) loop_tgt <= loop_tgt_in;

            // control side effects
            if (do_ctrl) begin
                case (reg_op)
                    `OP_CALL: shadow <= {v, c, n, z, pc + 12'd1};
                    `OP_HALT: begin
                        if (imm12 == 12'h0) halted <= 1'b1;
                        else begin
                            error      <= 1'b1;
                            error_code <= imm12;
                        end
                    end
                    `OP_IRQ: begin
                        irq_pending <= 1'b1;
                        irq_code    <= imm12;
                    end
                    default: ;
                endcase
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

// === FILE: rtl/top.sv ===
`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

// top: связка архитектурных узлов.
// Карта операндов (6 бит, 0..63):
//   0..31   — R0..R31 (регистры, R/W)
//   32..39  — системные:
//     32 ZERO (R=0, W=ignore)
//     33 FLAGS (R/W)
//     34 SHADOW (R/W)
//     35 LOOP.CNT (R/W)
//     36 LOOP.TGT (R/W)
//     37 BUSY (R only)
//     38 MHI (R only)
//     39 reserved
//   40..43  — DATA[0..3] (R/W)
//   44..47  — reserved
//   48..63  — каналы 4×4 (только W):
//     48 + 4*ch + 0: IDX      (W)
//     48 + 4*ch + 1: IDXH     (W)
//     48 + 4*ch + 2: STEP     (W)
//     48 + 4*ch + 3: MODE_PAGE (W, {PAGE[7:0], MODE[7:0]})
//   FLUSH — CTRL class, reg_op=7, imm12[1:0] = channel.
//   Спецоперанд-приёмник только в MOV (C3a).
module top (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst,
    output logic        halted,
    output logic        error,
    input  logic        start,
    input  logic        rom_we,
    input  logic [11:0] rom_addr,
    input  logic [31:0] rom_wdata,

    output logic        wb_cyc,
    output logic        wb_stb,
    output logic        wb_we,
    output logic [23:0] wb_adr,
    output logic [15:0] wb_dat_o,
    input  logic [15:0] wb_dat_i,
    input  logic        wb_ack
);

    // ===== ROM =====
    logic [11:0] pc;
    logic [31:0] insn;
    microcode_rom #(.DEPTH(4096), .ADDR_W(12), .DATA_W(32), .INIT_FILE("rtl/bootloader.hex")) rom (
        .clk(clk), .addr(pc), .data(insn),
        .we(rom_we), .waddr(rom_addr), .wdata(rom_wdata)
    );

    // ===== decode =====
    logic        l;
    logic [1:0]  imm_class;
    logic [4:0]  dst;
    logic        ds;
    logic [3:0]  cond;
    logic        f;
    logic [4:0]  reg_op;
    logic [5:0]  src;
    logic [11:0] imm12;
    logic        sx;

    assign l         = insn[31];
    assign imm_class = {insn[30], insn[29]};
    assign dst       = insn[28:24];
    assign ds        = insn[23];
    assign cond      = insn[22:19];
    assign f         = insn[18];
    assign reg_op    = insn[17:13];
    assign src       = insn[12:7];
    assign imm12     = insn[11:0];
    assign sx        = insn[12];

    // ===== flags =====
    logic z_r, n_r, c_r, v_r;
    logic z, n, c, v;
    assign z = z_r; assign n = n_r; assign c = c_r; assign v = v_r;

    // ===== register file =====
    logic [4:0]  ra, rb, wa;
    logic [15:0] rdata_a, rdata_b, wdata;
    logic        we;
    regfile rf (
        .clk(clk), .rst(rst),
        .ra(ra), .rdata_a(rdata_a),
        .rb(rb), .rdata_b(rdata_b),
        .we(we), .wa(wa), .wdata(wdata)
    );

    // ===== ALU =====
    logic [4:0]  alu_op;
    logic [15:0] alu_a, alu_b, alu_res, alu_mhi;
    logic        alu_nowrite;
    logic        alu_z, alu_n, alu_c, alu_v;
    alu al (
        .clk(clk), .rst(rst),
        .op(alu_op), .a(alu_a), .b(alu_b), .c_in(c_r),
        .res(alu_res), .mhi(alu_mhi), .nowrite(alu_nowrite),
        .z(alu_z), .n(alu_n), .c(alu_c), .v(alu_v)
    );

    // ===== sequencer =====
    logic [11:0] pc_next, error_code;
    logic [15:0] shadow;
    logic [15:0] loop_cnt;
    logic [11:0] loop_tgt;
    logic        irq_pending;
    logic [11:0] irq_code;
    logic [11:0] jmpr_target;
    logic        stall;
    sequencer seq (
        .clk(clk), .rst(rst), .start(start),
        .imm_class(imm_class), .reg_op(reg_op), .cond(cond),
        .l(l), .imm12(imm12),
        .z(z_r), .n(n_r), .c(c_r), .v(v_r),
        .jmpr_target(jmpr_target),
        .pc(pc), .pc_next(pc_next), .shadow(shadow),
        .loop_cnt(loop_cnt), .loop_tgt(loop_tgt),
        .halted(halted), .error(error), .error_code(error_code),
        .irq_pending(irq_pending), .irq_code(irq_code),
        .stall(stall),
        .loop_cnt_we(1'b0), .loop_cnt_in(16'h0),
        .loop_tgt_we(1'b0), .loop_tgt_in(12'h0)
    );

    // ===== pixel_engine =====
    logic [1:0]  pe_ch;
    logic        pe_mode_we;
    logic [2:0]  pe_mode_in;
    logic        pe_idxh_we;
    logic [2:0]  pe_idxh_in;
    logic        pe_idx_we;
    logic [15:0] pe_idx_in;
    logic        pe_step_we;
    logic [15:0] pe_step_in;
    logic        pe_access;
    logic [14:0] pe_word_out;
    logic [3:0]  pe_pos;
    logic [2:0]  pe_mode;
    logic        pe_prefetch_req;
    pixel_engine pe (
        .clk(clk), .rst(rst),
        .ch(pe_ch),
        .mode_we(pe_mode_we), .mode_in(pe_mode_in),
        .idxh_we(pe_idxh_we), .idxh_in(pe_idxh_in),
        .idx_we(pe_idx_we), .idx_in(pe_idx_in),
        .step_we(pe_step_we), .step_in(pe_step_in),
        .access(pe_access),
        .word_out(pe_word_out), .pos(pe_pos), .mode(pe_mode),
        .prefetch_req(pe_prefetch_req)
    );

    // ===== gpu_cache =====
    logic        gc_page_we;
    logic [7:0]  gc_page_in;
    logic [7:0]  gc_page_out;
    logic        gc_flush_en;
    logic [1:0]  gc_flush_ch;
    logic        gc_flush_done;
    logic        gc_access;
    logic        gc_we;
    logic [15:0] gc_wdata;
    logic        gc_hit;
    logic [15:0] gc_rdata;
    logic        gc_access_done;
    logic        gc_wb_cyc, gc_wb_stb, gc_wb_we;
    logic [23:0] gc_wb_adr;
    logic [15:0] gc_wb_dat_o;
    logic [23:0] gc_addr24;
    logic        gc_error;
    gpu_cache gc (
        .clk(clk), .rst(rst),
        .ch(pe_ch),
        .word_in(pe_word_out),
        .access(gc_access),
        .prefetch_req(pe_prefetch_req),
        .page_we(gc_page_we), .page_in(gc_page_in), .page_out(gc_page_out),
        .flush_en(gc_flush_en), .flush_ch(gc_flush_ch), .flush_done(gc_flush_done),
        .we(gc_we), .wdata(gc_wdata),
        .hit(gc_hit), .rdata(gc_rdata), .access_done(gc_access_done),
        .wb_cyc_o(gc_wb_cyc), .wb_stb_o(gc_wb_stb), .wb_we_o(gc_wb_we),
        .wb_adr_o(gc_wb_adr), .wb_dat_o(gc_wb_dat_o),
        .wb_ack_i(wb_ack), .wb_dat_i(wb_dat_i),
        .addr24(gc_addr24), .error(gc_error)
    );

    // ===== pixel_blender =====
    logic        pb_read;
    logic [2:0]  pb_mode;
    logic [3:0]  pb_pos;
    logic [15:0] pb_word_in, pb_pixel_in;
    logic [15:0] pb_pixel_out, pb_word_out;
    pixel_blender pb (
        .read(pb_read), .mode(pb_mode), .pos(pb_pos),
        .word_in(pb_word_in), .pixel_in(pb_pixel_in),
        .pixel_out(pb_pixel_out), .word_out(pb_word_out)
    );

    assign pb_mode     = pe_mode;
    assign pb_pos      = pe_pos;
    assign pb_word_in  = gc_rdata;
    assign pb_pixel_in = alu_res;

    // ===== Wishbone =====
    assign wb_cyc   = gc_wb_cyc;
    assign wb_stb   = gc_wb_stb;
    assign wb_we    = gc_wb_we;
    assign wb_adr   = gc_wb_adr;
    assign wb_dat_o = gc_wb_dat_o;

    // ===== operand codes =====
    logic [5:0]  dst_code, src_code;
    assign dst_code = {ds, dst};
    assign src_code = src;

    logic is_ctrl;
    assign is_ctrl = (imm_class == 2'b10);

    // ===== operand A (always from register file) =====
    assign ra = dst[4:0];
    assign alu_a = rdata_a;

    // ===== special read =====
    logic [15:0] sp_rd;

    always_comb begin
        sp_rd = 16'h0;

        if (src_code >= 6'd32 && src_code < 6'd40) begin
            // системные 32..39
            case (src_code)
                6'd32: sp_rd = 16'h0;                              // ZERO
                6'd33: sp_rd = {12'h0, v_r, c_r, n_r, z_r};        // FLAGS
                6'd34: sp_rd = shadow;                             // SHADOW
                6'd35: sp_rd = loop_cnt;                           // LOOP.CNT
                6'd36: sp_rd = {4'h0, loop_tgt};                   // LOOP.TGT
                6'd37: sp_rd = {12'h0, gc_wb_cyc, gc_flush_done, gc_access_done, gc_hit};  // BUSY
                6'd38: sp_rd = alu_mhi;                            // MHI
                6'd39: sp_rd = 16'h0;                              // reserved
                default: sp_rd = 16'h0;
            endcase
        end else if (src_code >= 6'd40 && src_code < 6'd44) begin
            // DATA[0..3] — read pixel
            sp_rd = pb_pixel_out;
        end else begin
            // 48..63 — каналы (только W). Чтение = 0.
            sp_rd = 16'h0;
        end
    end

    // ===== operand B =====
    assign rb = (imm_class == 2'b00 && src_code < 6'd32) ? src_code[4:0] : 5'd0;
    assign alu_b = (imm_class == 2'b11) ?
                   (sx && imm12[11] ? {4'hF, imm12} : {4'h0, imm12}) :
                   (src_code < 6'd32 ? rdata_b : sp_rd);

    // ===== ALU op =====
    assign alu_op = reg_op;

    // ===== writeback (R0..R31) =====
    // we должен быть 0, пока access не завершён (gc_access=1).
    // Иначе wdata (alu_res) защёлкивается со старым sp_rd (0) до fill.
    assign we    = !is_ctrl && !is_flush && !alu_nowrite && (dst_code < 6'd32);
    assign wa    = dst[4:0];
    assign wdata = alu_res;

    // ===== special write (dst_code >= 32, only MOV) =====
    logic is_mov;
    assign is_mov = (reg_op[4:3] == 2'b00 && reg_op[2:1] == 2'b00 && reg_op[0] == 1'b0);

    logic is_flush;
    assign is_flush = is_ctrl && (reg_op == 5'd7);

    always_comb begin
        pe_ch = 2'd0;
        pe_mode_we = 1'b0; pe_mode_in = 3'h0;
        pe_idxh_we = 1'b0; pe_idxh_in = 3'h0;
        pe_idx_we  = 1'b0; pe_idx_in  = 16'h0;
        pe_step_we = 1'b0; pe_step_in = 16'h0;
        pe_access  = 1'b0;
        gc_page_we = 1'b0; gc_page_in = 8'h0;
        gc_flush_en = 1'b0; gc_flush_ch = 2'd0;
        gc_access = 1'b0; gc_we = 1'b0; gc_wdata = 16'h0;
        pb_read = 1'b0;

        // --- special write (only MOV, dst_code >= 32) ---
        if (is_mov && dst_code >= 6'd32) begin
            if (dst_code < 6'd40) begin
                // системные 32..39: только FLAGS, SHADOW, LOOP.CNT, LOOP.TGT (R/W)
                // ZERO/BUSY/MHI — игнор
            end else if (dst_code < 6'd44) begin
                // DATA[0..3] (40..43): write
                pe_ch = dst_code[1:0];
                gc_access = 1'b1;
                gc_we = 1'b1;
                gc_wdata = alu_res;
            end else if (dst_code >= 6'd48) begin
                // каналы (48..63): 4 вида
                pe_ch = dst_code[3:2];
                case (dst_code[1:0])
                    2'd0: begin pe_idx_we  = 1'b1; pe_idx_in  = alu_res[15:0]; end
                    2'd1: begin pe_idxh_we = 1'b1; pe_idxh_in = alu_res[2:0];  end
                    2'd2: begin pe_step_we = 1'b1; pe_step_in = alu_res[15:0]; end
                    2'd3: begin
                        pe_mode_we = 1'b1; pe_mode_in = alu_res[2:0];
                        gc_page_we = 1'b1; gc_page_in = alu_res[15:8];
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end

        // --- DATA read (src_code 40..43) ---
        if (!is_ctrl && src_code >= 6'd40 && src_code < 6'd44) begin
            pe_ch = src_code[1:0];
            gc_access = 1'b1;
            gc_we = 1'b0;
            pe_access = 1'b1;
            pb_read = 1'b1;
        end

        // --- FLUSH: CTRL, reg_op=7, imm12[1:0] = channel ---
        if (is_flush) begin
            gc_flush_en = 1'b1;
            gc_flush_ch = imm12[1:0];
        end
    end

    // ===== stall =====
    assign stall = !halted && !error && (
        (gc_access && !gc_access_done) ||
        (is_flush && !gc_flush_done)
    );

    // ===== JMPR target =====
    assign jmpr_target = alu_res[11:0];

endmodule

// === FILE: rtl/top_fpga.sv ===
`timescale 1ns/1ps
module top_fpga (
    // clocks
    input  logic        clk_25mhz,
    input  logic        rst_btn,     // active high
    // SDRAM
    output logic [12:0] sdram_a,
    output logic [1:0]  sdram_ba,
    output logic        sdram_cke,
    output logic        sdram_cs_n,
    output logic        sdram_ras_n,
    output logic        sdram_cas_n,
    output logic        sdram_we_n,
    output logic [1:0]  sdram_dm,
    output logic        sdram_clk,
    inout  wire  [15:0] sdram_dq,
    // debug
    output logic [7:0]  debug_leds
);

    // ===== reset =====
    logic rst;
    logic clk;
    assign clk = clk_25mhz;
    // simple 2-FF reset synchronizer
    logic [1:0] rst_sync;
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        rst_sync <= {rst_sync[0], rst_btn};
    end
    assign rst = rst_sync[1];

    // ===== GPU top =====
    logic        gpu_req, gpu_we, gpu_ack0, gpu_ack1;
    logic [23:0] gpu_addr;
    logic [15:0] gpu_wdata, gpu_rdata;
    logic [1:0]  gpu_sel;
    logic        halted, error;
    logic        start;
    logic        rom_we;
    logic [11:0] rom_addr;
    logic [31:0] rom_wdata;

    // start: simple - start once reset released, after a short delay
    logic [7:0] start_cnt;
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            start_cnt <= 8'd0;
            start <= 1'b0;
        end else if (start_cnt != 8'hFF) begin
            start_cnt <= start_cnt + 8'd1;
            if (start_cnt == 8'd200) start <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
            start <= 1'b0;
        end
    end

    // ROM load: disable (microcode.hex in BRAM)
    assign rom_we    = 1'b0;
    assign rom_addr  = 12'h0;
    assign rom_wdata = 32'h0;

    top u_gpu (
        .clk(clk), .rst(rst),
        .halted(halted), .error(error),
        .gpu_req(gpu_req), .gpu_we(gpu_we),
        .gpu_addr(gpu_addr), .gpu_wdata(gpu_wdata), .gpu_sel(gpu_sel),
        .gpu_ack0(gpu_ack0), .gpu_ack1(gpu_ack1), .gpu_rdata(gpu_rdata),
        .rom_we(rom_we), .rom_addr(rom_addr), .rom_wdata(rom_wdata),
        .start(start)
    );

    // ===== memory_arbiter =====
    logic        wb_cyc, wb_stb, wb_ack, wb_we;
    logic [23:0] wb_adr;
    logic [7:0]  wb_dat_o, wb_dat_i;
    logic [2:0]  wb_tag;
    logic        wb_grant;

    logic [23:0] video_addr;
    logic        video_req, video_ack0, video_ack1;
    logic [15:0] video_data;

    logic [23:0] sdram_addr;
    logic [15:0] sdram_data_o, sdram_data_i;
    logic        sdram_we, sdram_req, sdram_ack0, sdram_ack1;
    logic [1:0]  sdram_sel;

    assign wb_cyc = 1'b0;
    assign wb_stb = 1'b0;
    assign wb_we  = 1'b0;
    assign wb_adr = 24'h0;
    assign wb_dat_i = 8'h0;
    assign wb_tag = 3'b0;
    assign video_req = 1'b0;
    assign video_addr = 24'h0;

    memory_arbiter u_arb (
        .clk_i(clk), .clke_i(1'b1), .rst(rst),
        .wb_cyc_i(wb_cyc), .wb_stb_i(wb_stb), .wb_ack_o(wb_ack),
        .wb_we_i(wb_we), .wb_adr_i(wb_adr), .wb_dat_i(wb_dat_i),
        .wb_dat_o(wb_dat_o), .wb_tag_i(wb_tag), .wb_grant_o(wb_grant),
        .video_addr_i(video_addr), .video_req_i(video_req),
        .video_data_o(video_data),
        .video_ack0_o(video_ack0), .video_ack1_o(video_ack1),
        .gpu_addr_i(gpu_addr), .gpu_req_i(gpu_req),
        .gpu_we_i(gpu_we), .gpu_dat_i(gpu_wdata),
        .gpu_dat_o(gpu_rdata),
        .gpu_ack0_o(gpu_ack0), .gpu_ack1_o(gpu_ack1),
        .gpu_sel_i(gpu_sel),
        .sdram_addr_o(sdram_addr), .sdram_data_o(sdram_data_o),
        .sdram_data_i(sdram_data_i), .sdram_we_o(sdram_we),
        .sdram_req_o(sdram_req),
        .sdram_ack0_i(sdram_ack0), .sdram_ack1_i(sdram_ack1),
        .sdram_sel_o(sdram_sel),
        .debug_state_o(), .debug_wb_active_o(),
        .debug_gpu_active_o(), .debug_video_active_o()
    );

    // ===== sdram_ctrl (placeholder — use your existing sdram_ctrl_wb) =====
    // ...
    // For now, tie off (GPU will hang on first memory access).
    assign sdram_ack0 = 1'b0;
    assign sdram_ack1 = 1'b0;
    assign sdram_data_i = 16'h0;
    assign sdram_a  = 13'h0;
    assign sdram_ba = 2'b0;
    assign sdram_cke = 1'b0;
    assign sdram_cs_n = 1'b1;
    assign sdram_ras_n = 1'b1;
    assign sdram_cas_n = 1'b1;
    assign sdram_we_n = 1'b1;
    assign sdram_dm = 2'b11;
    assign sdram_clk = 1'b0;

    // ===== debug =====
    assign debug_leds = {6'h0, error, halted};

endmodule

#include "image_io.h"
