// =========================================================
// Палитры
// =========================================================

// EGA/VGA 16 цветов (0x00RRGGBB)
const uint32_t vga16_palette[16] = {
    0x000000, 0x0000AA, 0x00AA00, 0x00AAAA,
    0xAA0000, 0xAA00AA, 0xAA5500, 0xAAAAAA,
    0x555555, 0x5555FF, 0x55FF55, 0x55FFFF,
    0xFF5555, 0xFF55FF, 0xFFFF55, 0xFFFFFF,
};

// Web-safe 216 + 40 серых. Инициализация один раз.
static uint32_t g_websafe216[256];
static bool     g_websafe216_done = false;

static void init_websafe216() {
    if (g_websafe216_done) return;
    int idx = 0;
    for (int r = 0; r < 6; r++)
        for (int g = 0; g < 6; g++)
            for (int b = 0; b < 6; b++) {
                uint32_t R = (uint32_t)(r * 51);
                uint32_t G = (uint32_t)(g * 51);
                uint32_t B = (uint32_t)(b * 51);
                g_websafe216[idx++] = (R << 16) | (G << 8) | B;
            }
    // 40 градаций серого (0..255)
    for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
        uint32_t v = (uint32_t)((i * 255 + 39) / 40);
        g_websafe216[idx++] = (v << 16) | (v << 8) | v;
    }
    g_websafe216_done = true;
}

const uint32_t* get_websafe216_palette() {
    init_websafe216();
    return g_websafe216;
}

// =========================================================
// Утилиты
// =========================================================

int bits_per_pixel(PixelFormat fmt) {
    switch (fmt) {
        case PixelFormat::BPP1:  return 1;
        case PixelFormat::BPP4:  return 4;
        case PixelFormat::BPP8:  return 8;
        case PixelFormat::BPP16: return 16;
    }
    return 0;
}

bool parse_format(const std::string& s, PixelFormat& fmt) {
    if (s == "1bpp")  { fmt = PixelFormat::BPP1;  return true; }
    if (s == "4bpp")  { fmt = PixelFormat::BPP4;  return true; }
    if (s == "8bpp")  { fmt = PixelFormat::BPP8;  return true; }
    if (s == "16bpp") { fmt = PixelFormat::BPP16; return true; }
    return false;
}

const char* format_name(PixelFormat fmt) {
    switch (fmt) {
        case PixelFormat::BPP1:  return "1bpp";
        case PixelFormat::BPP4:  return "4bpp";
        case PixelFormat::BPP8:  return "8bpp";
        case PixelFormat::BPP16: return "16bpp";
    }
    return "?";
}

bool check_resolution(int w, int h, PixelFormat fmt, std::string& err) {
    int bpp = bits_per_pixel(fmt);
    if (bpp == 0) { err = "unknown format"; return false; }
    uint64_t need_bits  = (uint64_t)w * h * bpp;
    uint64_t need_bytes = (need_bits + 7) / 8;
    if (need_bytes > 65536) {
        char buf[256];
        snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
                 "resolution %dx%d @ %dbpp needs %llu bytes, max 65536",
                 w, h, bpp, (unsigned long long)need_bytes);
        err = buf;
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// =========================================================
// I/O
// =========================================================

bool read_image(const std::string& path, Image& out) {
    int w = 0, h = 0, n = 0;
    stbi_uc* data = stbi_load(path.c_str(), &w, &h, &n, 4);
    if (!data) {
        fprintf(stderr, "read_image: cannot load '%s': %s\n",
                path.c_str(), stbi_failure_reason());
        return false;
    }
    out.width  = w;
    out.height = h;
    out.rgba.assign(data, data + (size_t)w * h * 4);
    stbi_image_free(data);
    return true;
}

bool write_image(const std::string& path, const Image& img) {
    if (img.rgba.size() != (size_t)img.width * img.height * 4) {
        fprintf(stderr, "write_image: bad rgba size\n");
        return false;
    }
    int ok = stbi_write_png(path.c_str(), img.width, img.height,
                            4, img.rgba.data(), img.width * 4);
    if (!ok) {
        fprintf(stderr, "write_image: cannot write '%s'\n", path.c_str());
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// =========================================================
// Квантование / де-квантование
// =========================================================

static inline uint32_t dist2(uint32_t a, uint32_t b) {
    int dr = (int)((a >> 16) & 0xFF) - (int)((b >> 16) & 0xFF);
    int dg = (int)((a >> 8)  & 0xFF) - (int)((b >> 8)  & 0xFF);
    int db = (int)( a        & 0xFF) - (int)( b        & 0xFF);
    return (uint32_t)(dr*dr + dg*dg + db*db);
}

std::vector<uint8_t> quantize(const Image& img, PixelFormat fmt,
                              const uint32_t* palette, int palette_size) {
    size_t n_pixels = (size_t)img.width * img.height;

    if (fmt == PixelFormat::BPP16) {
        std::vector<uint8_t> out(n_pixels * 2);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_pixels; i++) {
            uint8_t R = img.rgba[i*4+0];
            uint8_t G = img.rgba[i*4+1];
            uint8_t B = img.rgba[i*4+2];
            uint16_t v = (uint16_t)(((R >> 3) << 11) | ((G >> 2) << 5) | (B >> 3));
            out[i*2+0] = (uint8_t)(v & 0xFF);
            out[i*2+1] = (uint8_t)((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
        }
        return out;
    }

    // 1/4/8 bpp: 1 байт на индекс
    std::vector<uint8_t> out(n_pixels);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n_pixels; i++) {
        uint32_t rgb = ((uint32_t)img.rgba[i*4+0] << 16) |
                       ((uint32_t)img.rgba[i*4+1] << 8)  |
                        (uint32_t)img.rgba[i*4+2];
        uint32_t best_d = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
        int best_i = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < palette_size; j++) {
            uint32_t d = dist2(rgb, palette[j]);
            if (d < best_d) { best_d = d; best_i = j; }
        }
        out[i] = (uint8_t)best_i;
    }
    return out;
}

Image dequantize(const std::vector<uint8_t>& indices, int w, int h,
                 PixelFormat fmt, const uint32_t* palette) {
    Image out;
    out.width = w;
    out.height = h;
    out.rgba.resize((size_t)w * h * 4);
    size_t n_pixels = (size_t)w * h;

    if (fmt == PixelFormat::BPP16) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_pixels; i++) {
            uint16_t v = (uint16_t)(indices[i*2] | (indices[i*2+1] << 8));
            uint8_t R = (uint8_t)(((v >> 11) & 0x1F) * 255 / 31);
            uint8_t G = (uint8_t)(((v >> 5)  & 0x3F) * 255 / 63);
            uint8_t B = (uint8_t)(( v        & 0x1F) * 255 / 31);
            out.rgba[i*4+0] = R;
            out.rgba[i*4+1] = G;
            out.rgba[i*4+2] = B;
            out.rgba[i*4+3] = 255;
        }
        return out;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < n_pixels; i++) {
        uint32_t c = palette[indices[i]];
        out.rgba[i*4+0] = (uint8_t)((c >> 16) & 0xFF);
        out.rgba[i*4+1] = (uint8_t)((c >> 8)  & 0xFF);
        out.rgba[i*4+2] = (uint8_t)( c        & 0xFF);
        out.rgba[i*4+3] = 255;
    }
    return out;
}

// =========================================================
// Упаковка / распаковка
// =========================================================

std::vector<uint16_t> pack_pixels(const std::vector<uint8_t>& indices,
                                  int w, int h, PixelFormat fmt) {
    size_t n_pixels = (size_t)w * h;
    std::vector<uint16_t> words;

    if (fmt == PixelFormat::BPP16) {
        words.resize(n_pixels);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_pixels; i++) {
            words[i] = (uint16_t)(indices[i*2] | (indices[i*2+1] << 8));
        }
        return words;
    }

    if (fmt == PixelFormat::BPP8) {
        size_t n_words = (n_pixels + 1) / 2;
        words.assign(n_words, 0);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_pixels; i++) {
            size_t wi = i / 2;
            int pos = (int)(i & 1);
            if (pos == 0) words[wi] |= (uint16_t)((uint16_t)indices[i] << 8);
            else          words[wi] |= (uint16_t)indices[i];
        }
        return words;
    }

    if (fmt == PixelFormat::BPP4) {
        size_t n_words = (n_pixels + 3) / 4;
        words.assign(n_words, 0);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_pixels; i++) {
            size_t wi = i / 4;
            int pos = (int)(i & 3);
            int shift = (3 - pos) * 4;
            words[wi] |= (uint16_t)(((uint16_t)(indices[i] & 0xF)) << shift);
        }
        return words;
    }

    if (fmt == PixelFormat::BPP1) {
        size_t n_words = (n_pixels + 15) / 16;
        words.assign(n_words, 0);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_pixels; i++) {
            size_t wi = i / 16;
            int pos = (int)(i & 15);
            int shift = 15 - pos;
            words[wi] |= (uint16_t)(((uint16_t)(indices[i] & 1)) << shift);
        }
        return words;
    }

    return words;
}

std::vector<uint8_t> unpack_pixels(const std::vector<uint16_t>& words,
                                   int w, int h, PixelFormat fmt) {
    size_t n_pixels = (size_t)w * h;

    if (fmt == PixelFormat::BPP16) {
        std::vector<uint8_t> out(n_pixels * 2);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_pixels; i++) {
            uint16_t v = words[i];
            out[i*2+0] = (uint8_t)(v & 0xFF);
            out[i*2+1] = (uint8_t)((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
        }
        return out;
    }

    std::vector<uint8_t> out(n_pixels, 0);

    if (fmt == PixelFormat::BPP8) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_pixels; i++) {
            size_t wi = i / 2;
            int pos = (int)(i & 1);
            out[i] = (pos == 0) ? (uint8_t)((words[wi] >> 8) & 0xFF)
                                : (uint8_t)( words[wi]       & 0xFF);
        }
        return out;
    }

    if (fmt == PixelFormat::BPP4) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_pixels; i++) {
            size_t wi = i / 4;
            int pos = (int)(i & 3);
            int shift = (3 - pos) * 4;
            out[i] = (uint8_t)((words[wi] >> shift) & 0xF);
        }
        return out;
    }

    if (fmt == PixelFormat::BPP1) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_pixels; i++) {
            size_t wi = i / 16;
            int pos = (int)(i & 15);
            int shift = 15 - pos;
            out[i] = (uint8_t)((words[wi] >> shift) & 0x1);
        }
        return out;
    }

    return out;
}

// === FILE: sim/image_io.h ===
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
#include <string>

struct Image {
    int width  = 0;
    int height = 0;
    std::vector<uint8_t> rgba;  // w*h*4, порядок R,G,B,A
};

enum class PixelFormat { BPP1, BPP4, BPP8, BPP16 };

// --- I/O ---
bool read_image(const std::string& path, Image& out);
bool write_image(const std::string& path, const Image& img);

// --- Палитры (указатели, гарантированно валидные после первого вызова) ---
// vga16: 16 цветов EGA/VGA, доступна всегда (статическая таблица).
extern const uint32_t vga16_palette[16];

// websafe216: 216 web-safe + 40 серых, инициализируется при первом обращении.
const uint32_t* get_websafe216_palette();   // вернёт указатель на 256 элементов

// --- Конвертация ---
std::vector<uint8_t>  quantize(const Image& img, PixelFormat fmt,
                               const uint32_t* palette, int palette_size);
Image                 dequantize(const std::vector<uint8_t>& indices, int w, int h,
                                 PixelFormat fmt, const uint32_t* palette);
std::vector<uint16_t> pack_pixels(const std::vector<uint8_t>& indices, int w, int h,
                                  PixelFormat fmt);
std::vector<uint8_t>  unpack_pixels(const std::vector<uint16_t>& words, int w, int h,
                                    PixelFormat fmt);

// --- Утилиты ---
int bits_per_pixel(PixelFormat fmt);
bool parse_format(const std::string& s, PixelFormat& fmt);
const char* format_name(PixelFormat fmt);
bool check_resolution(int w, int h, PixelFormat fmt, std::string& err);

// === FILE: sim/main_image_roundtrip.cpp ===
#include "image_io.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>

static void usage(const char* prog) {
    fprintf(stderr,
        "usage: %s <in.png> <out.png> <fmt>\n"
        "  fmt: 1bpp | 4bpp | 8bpp | 16bpp\n"
        "  Тест: PNG -> pack -> mem[] -> unpack -> PNG (без GPU)\n",
        prog);
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc != 4) { usage(argv[0]); return 1; }

    const char* in_path  = argv[1];
    const char* out_path = argv[2];
    const char* fmt_str  = argv[3];

    PixelFormat fmt;
    if (!parse_format(fmt_str, fmt)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "unknown format: %s\n", fmt_str);
        return 1;
    }

    Image img;
    if (!read_image(in_path, img)) return 1;
    printf("read  %s: %dx%d\n", in_path, img.width, img.height);

    std::string err;
    if (!check_resolution(img.width, img.height, fmt, err)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "error: %s\n", err.c_str());
        return 1;
    }

    // Выбор палитры
    const uint32_t* palette = nullptr;
    int palette_size = 0;
    if (fmt == PixelFormat::BPP4) {
        palette = vga16_palette; palette_size = 16;
    } else if (fmt == PixelFormat::BPP8) {
        palette = get_websafe216_palette(); palette_size = 256;
    } else if (fmt == PixelFormat::BPP1) {
        palette = vga16_palette; palette_size = 2;  // только 2 цвета
    }

    // 1) RGBA -> индексы
    std::vector<uint8_t> indices = quantize(img, fmt, palette, palette_size);

    // 2) индексы -> слова (эмуляция того, что лежит в mem[])
    std::vector<uint16_t> words = pack_pixels(indices, img.width, img.height, fmt);
    printf("packed %zu words (%zu bytes)\n", words.size(), words.size() * 2);

    // 3) слова -> индексы (эмуляция чтения из mem[] через pixel_packer)
    std::vector<uint8_t> indices2 = unpack_pixels(words, img.width, img.height, fmt);

    // 4) индексы -> RGBA -> PNG
    Image out = dequantize(indices2, img.width, img.height, fmt, palette);
    if (!write_image(out_path, out)) return 1;
    printf("wrote %s: %dx%d (%s)\n", out_path, out.width, out.height, format_name(fmt));

    // Проверка идемпотентности
    int diff = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < indices.size(); i++) {
        if (indices[i] != indices2[i]) diff++;
    }
    if (diff != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "WARNING: %d indices differ after roundtrip!\n", diff);
        return 1;
    }
    printf("roundtrip OK: %zu pixels, 0 differences\n", indices.size());
    return 0;
}

// === FILE: sim/main_pixel_buffer.cpp ===
#include "Vtb_pixel_buffer_wrapper.h"
#include "verilated.h"
#include <cstdio>

static Vtb_pixel_buffer_wrapper* dut;

static void tick() {
    dut->clk = 0; dut->eval();
    dut->clk = 1; dut->eval();
    dut->clk = 0; dut->eval();
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    Verilated::commandArgs(argc, argv);
    dut = new Vtb_pixel_buffer_wrapper;

    dut->rst = 1;
    tick(); tick();
    dut->rst = 0;

    // fill page 0, tag 0x100, word 0xFFFF
    dut->ch = 1;
    dut->addr24 = 0x000100;
    dut->fill_en = 1; dut->fill_data = 0xFFFF;
    tick();
    dut->fill_en = 0;
    tick();
    if (!dut->hit) { printf("FAIL fill: not hit\n"); return 1; }
    if (dut->rdata != 0xFFFF) { printf("FAIL fill: rdata=%04X\n", dut->rdata); return 1; }
    printf("fill OK: hit=1 rdata=%04X\n", dut->rdata);

    // write we=1, wdata=0xAFFF
    dut->we = 1; dut->wdata = 0xAFFF;
    tick();
    dut->we = 0;
    tick();
    if (dut->dirty1 != 1) { printf("FAIL write: dirty1=%d\n", dut->dirty1); return 1; }
    if (dut->data1 != 0xAFFF) { printf("FAIL write: data1=%04X\n", dut->data1); return 1; }
    printf("write OK: dirty1=1 data1=%04X\n", dut->data1);

    // flush
    dut->flush_en = 1;
    tick(); tick();
    dut->flush_en = 0;
    tick();
    if (!dut->wb_req) { printf("FAIL flush: no wb_req\n"); return 1; }
    if (dut->wb_addr != 0x200) { printf("FAIL flush: wb_addr=%06X\n", dut->wb_addr); return 1; }
    if (dut->wb_data != 0xAFFF) { printf("FAIL flush: wb_data=%04X\n", dut->wb_data); return 1; }
    printf("flush OK: wb_req=1 wb_addr=%06X wb_data=%04X\n", dut->wb_addr, dut->wb_data);

    // ack
    dut->wb_ack = 1;
    tick(); tick();
    dut->wb_ack = 0;
    tick();
    if (dut->wb_req) { printf("FAIL ack: wb_req still high\n"); return 1; }
    printf("ack OK: wb_req=0\n");

    printf("ALL PASS\n");
    delete dut;
    return 0;
}

// === FILE: sim/main_top.cpp ===
#include "Vtb_top_wrapper.h"
#include "Vtb_top_wrapper___024root.h"
#include "verilated.h"
#include "verilated_vcd_c.h"
#include "image_io.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>
#include <string>

static Vtb_top_wrapper* dut;
static VerilatedVcdC* tfp_p = nullptr;
static uint64_t cycles = 0;

#define MEM_WORDS 32768
static uint16_t mem[MEM_WORDS];

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Тактирование + эмуляция WB-памяти
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
static void step() {
    dut->wb_ack = 0;
    dut->wb_dat_i = 0;
    if (dut->wb_cyc && dut->wb_stb) {
        uint32_t a = (dut->wb_adr >> 1) & (MEM_WORDS - 1);
        printf("WB: adr=%06X a=%04X we=%d dat_o=%04X mem=%04X\n",
               (unsigned)dut->wb_adr, a, (int)dut->wb_we,
               (unsigned)dut->wb_dat_o, mem[a]);
        if (dut->wb_we) mem[a] = dut->wb_dat_o;
        else           dut->wb_dat_i = mem[a];
        dut->wb_ack = 1;
    }
    dut->eval();
    dut->clk = 1; dut->eval();
    if (tfp_p) tfp_p->dump(cycles);
    dut->clk = 0; dut->eval();
    ++cycles;
}

static void load_rom(uint16_t addr, uint32_t w) {
    dut->rom_we = 1; dut->rom_addr = addr; dut->rom_wdata = w;
    step();
    dut->rom_we = 0;
}

static void load_file(const char* path, uint32_t byte_off) {
    FILE* f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) { printf("cannot open %s\n", path); return; }
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END); long sz = ftell(f); fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf(sz);
    fread(buf.data(), 1, sz, f); fclose(f);
    for (long i = 0; i + 1 < sz; i += 2) {
        uint32_t w = (byte_off + i) / 2;
        if (w < MEM_WORDS) mem[w] = buf[i] | (buf[i+1] << 8);
    }
    printf("loaded %s (%ld bytes) at 0x%X\n", path, sz, byte_off);
}

static void save_file(const char* path, uint32_t byte_off, uint32_t size) {
    FILE* f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) { printf("cannot write %s\n", path); return; }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < size; i += 2) {
        uint32_t w = (byte_off + i) / 2;
        uint16_t v = (w < MEM_WORDS) ? mem[w] : 0;
        fputc(v & 0xFF, f); fputc(v >> 8, f);
    }
    fclose(f);
    printf("saved %s (%u bytes) from 0x%X\n", path, size, byte_off);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Выбор палитры по формату
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
static const uint32_t* palette_for(PixelFormat fmt, int& out_n) {
    switch (fmt) {
        case PixelFormat::BPP1:  out_n = 2;   return vga16_palette;
        case PixelFormat::BPP4:  out_n = 16;  return vga16_palette;
        case PixelFormat::BPP8:  out_n = 256; return get_websafe216_palette();
        default:                 out_n = 0;   return nullptr;
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Загрузка PNG в mem[]
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
static bool load_png_into_mem(const char* path, PixelFormat fmt,
                              uint32_t byte_off,
                              int expect_w, int expect_h,
                              size_t& out_words) {
    Image img;
    if (!read_image(path, img)) return false;

    if (expect_w && img.width  != expect_w) {
        fprintf(stderr, "load_png: width mismatch (%d != %d)\n", img.width, expect_w);
        return false;
    }
    if (expect_h && img.height != expect_h) {
        fprintf(stderr, "load_png: height mismatch (%d != %d)\n", img.height, expect_h);
        return false;
    }

    std::string err;
    if (!check_resolution(img.width, img.height, fmt, err)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "load_png: %s\n", err.c_str());
        return false;
    }

    int pal_n = 0;
    const uint32_t* pal = palette_for(fmt, pal_n);

    std::vector<uint8_t>  idx   = quantize(img, fmt, pal, pal_n);
    std::vector<uint16_t> words = pack_pixels(idx, img.width, img.height, fmt);

    uint32_t base_word = byte_off / 2;
    if (base_word + words.size() > MEM_WORDS) {
        fprintf(stderr, "load_png: PNG overflows memory (%zu words at 0x%X)\n",
                words.size(), byte_off);
        return false;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < words.size(); i++) mem[base_word + i] = words[i];

    printf("loaded %s (%dx%d, %s) at byte offset 0x%X (%zu words)\n",
           path, img.width, img.height, format_name(fmt),
           byte_off, words.size());
    out_words = words.size();
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Дамп mem[] в PNG
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
static bool dump_mem_to_png(const char* path, PixelFormat fmt,
                            uint32_t byte_off, int w, int h) {
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "dump_png: invalid dimensions %dx%d\n", w, h);
        return false;
    }
    std::string err;
    if (!check_resolution(w, h, fmt, err)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "dump_png: %s\n", err.c_str());
        return false;
    }

    int bpp = bits_per_pixel(fmt);
    size_t n_bits  = (size_t)w * h * bpp;
    size_t n_words = (n_bits + 15) / 16;

    std::vector<uint16_t> words(n_words);
    uint32_t base_word = byte_off / 2;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n_words; i++) {
        words[i] = (base_word + i < MEM_WORDS) ? mem[base_word + i] : 0;
    }

    std::vector<uint8_t> idx = unpack_pixels(words, w, h, fmt);

    int pal_n = 0;
    const uint32_t* pal = palette_for(fmt, pal_n);

    Image out = dequantize(idx, w, h, fmt, pal);
    if (!write_image(path, out)) return false;

    printf("dumped %s (%dx%d, %s) from byte offset 0x%X\n",
           path, w, h, format_name(fmt), byte_off);
    return true;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// main
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    Verilated::commandArgs(argc, argv);
    dut = new Vtb_top_wrapper;

    VerilatedVcdC tfp;      // локальный
    tfp_p = &tfp;
    Verilated::traceEverOn(true);
    dut->trace(&tfp, 99);
    tfp.open("sim/trace.vcd");

    // ---- старые аргументы (raw binary) ----
    const char* prog = nullptr;
    const char* s1 = nullptr; uint32_t s1_off_raw = 0x1000;
    const char* s2 = nullptr; uint32_t s2_off_raw = 0x2000;
    const char* dst_raw = nullptr; uint32_t dst_off_raw = 0x3000, dst_size_raw = 0x1000;

    // ---- новые аргументы (PNG) ----
    const char* s1in_path = nullptr;
    PixelFormat s1fmt = PixelFormat::BPP8;
    uint32_t    s1in_off = 0;
    int         s1in_w = 0, s1in_h = 0;

    const char* dout_path = nullptr;
    PixelFormat dfmt = PixelFormat::BPP8;
    uint32_t    dout_off = 0;
    int         dout_w = 0, dout_h = 0;

    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        if      (!strcmp(argv[i], "-p")     && i+1 < argc) prog = argv[++i];
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-s1")    && i+1 < argc) s1 = argv[++i];
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-s2")    && i+1 < argc) s2 = argv[++i];
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-d")     && i+1 < argc) dst_raw = argv[++i];
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-s1off") && i+1 < argc) s1_off_raw = strtoul(argv[++i], 0, 0);
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-s2off") && i+1 < argc) s2_off_raw = strtoul(argv[++i], 0, 0);
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-doff")  && i+1 < argc) dst_off_raw = strtoul(argv[++i], 0, 0);
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-dsize") && i+1 < argc) dst_size_raw = strtoul(argv[++i], 0, 0);

        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-s1in")  && i+1 < argc) s1in_path = argv[++i];
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-s1fmt") && i+1 < argc) {
            if (!parse_format(argv[++i], s1fmt)) { fprintf(stderr, "bad -s1fmt\n"); return 1; }
        }
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-s1off") && i+1 < argc) { /* уже разобрано выше как raw */ }
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-s1woff")&& i+1 < argc) s1in_off = strtoul(argv[++i], 0, 0);
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-s1w")   && i+1 < argc) s1in_w = atoi(argv[++i]);
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-s1h")   && i+1 < argc) s1in_h = atoi(argv[++i]);

        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-dout")  && i+1 < argc) dout_path = argv[++i];
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-dfmt")  && i+1 < argc) {
            if (!parse_format(argv[++i], dfmt)) { fprintf(stderr, "bad -dfmt\n"); return 1; }
        }
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-doff")  && i+1 < argc) { /* уже разобрано выше как raw */ }
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-dwoff") && i+1 < argc) dout_off = strtoul(argv[++i], 0, 0);
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-dw")    && i+1 < argc) dout_w = atoi(argv[++i]);
        else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "-dh")    && i+1 < argc) dout_h = atoi(argv[++i]);

        else {
            fprintf(stderr, "unknown arg: %s\n", argv[i]);
            return 1;
        }
    }

    if (s1in_path) s1in_off = s1_off_raw;
    if (dout_path) dout_off = dst_off_raw;

    memset(mem, 0, sizeof(mem));

    dut->rst = 1; dut->start = 0;
    dut->rom_we = 0; dut->wb_ack = 0; dut->wb_dat_i = 0;
    step(); step();
    dut->rst = 0; step();

    if (prog) {
        FILE* f = fopen(prog, "r");
        if (!f) { fprintf(stderr, "cannot open %s\n", prog); return 1; }
        char line[256]; uint16_t a = 0;
        while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), f)) {
            char* p = line;
            while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;
            if (*p == '\0' || *p == '\n' || *p == ';' || *p == '#') continue;
            uint32_t w = strtoul(p, nullptr, 16);
            load_rom(a++, w);
            printf("  [%03X] %08X\n", (unsigned)(a-1), w);
        }
        fclose(f);
        printf("loaded microcode %s (%u words)\n", prog, a);
    }

    if (s1) load_file(s1, s1_off_raw);
    if (s2) load_file(s2, s2_off_raw);

    if (s1in_path) {
        size_t n_words = 0;
        if (!load_png_into_mem(s1in_path, s1fmt, s1in_off, s1in_w, s1in_h, n_words))
            return 1;
    }

    dut->start = 1; step(); dut->start = 0;

    // ---- прогон с отладкой первых 30 тактов ----
    uint64_t limit = 100000000ULL;
    while (!dut->halted && !dut->error && cycles < limit) {
if (cycles >= 29 && cycles < 90) {
    printf("cyc=%2llu pc=%03X gc_acc=%d pe_pos=%d gc_rdata=%04X stall=%d we=%d\n",
           (unsigned long long)cycles,
           (unsigned)dut->rootp->tb_top_wrapper__DOT__u_top__DOT__pc,
           (int)dut->rootp->tb_top_wrapper__DOT__u_top__DOT__gc_access,
           (int)dut->rootp->tb_top_wrapper__DOT__u_top__DOT__pe_pos,
           (unsigned)dut->rootp->tb_top_wrapper__DOT__u_top__DOT__gc_rdata,
           (int)dut->rootp->tb_top_wrapper__DOT__u_top__DOT__stall,
           (int)dut->rootp->tb_top_wrapper__DOT__u_top__DOT__we);
}
        step();
    }


    if (!dut->halted) {
        printf("FAIL: not halted (cycles=%llu)\n", (unsigned long long)cycles);
        return 1;
    }
    if (dut->error) {
        printf("FAIL: error\n");
        return 1;
    }
    printf("HALTED: cycles=%llu\n", (unsigned long long)cycles);

    printf("registers R0..R31:\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
        printf("  R%02d = %04X\n", i, (unsigned)dut->rootp->tb_top_wrapper__DOT__u_top__DOT__rf__DOT__mem_a[i]);
    }

    printf("mem[0x000]=%04X mem[0x100]=%04X mem[0x180]=%04X mem[0x200]=%04X\n",
           mem[0x000], mem[0x100], mem[0x180], mem[0x200]);

    if (dst_raw) save_file(dst_raw, dst_off_raw, dst_size_raw);

    if (dout_path) {
        if (!dump_mem_to_png(dout_path, dfmt, dout_off, dout_w, dout_h))
            return 1;
    }

    tfp_p = nullptr;
    tfp.close();
    delete dut;

   return 0;
}

// === FILE: sim/memory_arbiter_stub.sv ===
`timescale 1ns/1ps
// Stub of memory_arbiter's GPU port for testbenching top.sv without SDRAM.
// Responds to gpu_req with ack0 (first word) then ack1 (second word).
// Reads/writes a 16-bit memory array indexed by gpu_addr>>1.
module memory_arbiter_stub #(
    parameter int MEM_WORDS = 32768
) (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst,

    // GPU port (same as memory_arbiter)
    input  logic [23:0] gpu_addr_i,
    input  logic        gpu_req_i,
    input  logic        gpu_we_i,
    input  logic [15:0] gpu_dat_i,
    output logic [15:0] gpu_dat_o,
    output logic        gpu_ack0_o,
    output logic        gpu_ack1_o,
    input  logic [1:0]  gpu_sel_i,
    input  logic        debug_mem0_we,
    input  logic [15:0] debug_mem0_data,
    output logic [15:0] debug_mem0
);

    logic [15:0] mem [0:MEM_WORDS-1];

    typedef enum logic [1:0] { S_IDLE, S_ACK0, S_ACK1 } state_t;
    state_t state;

    logic [23:0] saved_addr;
    logic        saved_we;
    logic [15:0] saved_wdata;

    // test can write to mem directly: dut.u_arb.mem[word_addr] = 16'hXXXX;

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            state       <= S_IDLE;
            saved_addr  <= 24'h0;
            saved_we    <= 1'b0;
            saved_wdata <= 16'h0;
        end else begin
            if (debug_mem0_we) mem[0] <= debug_mem0_data;
            case (state)
                S_IDLE: begin
                    if (gpu_req_i) begin
                        saved_addr  <= gpu_addr_i;
                        saved_we    <= gpu_we_i;
                        saved_wdata <= gpu_dat_i;
                        state       <= S_ACK0;
                    end
                end
                S_ACK0: begin
                    if (saved_we) begin
                        mem[saved_addr[16:1]] <= saved_wdata;
                    end
                    state <= S_ACK1;
                end
                S_ACK1: begin
                    state <= S_IDLE;
                end
                default: state <= S_IDLE;
            endcase
        end
    end

    assign gpu_ack0_o = (state == S_ACK0);
    assign gpu_ack1_o = (state == S_ACK1);
    assign gpu_dat_o  = mem[saved_addr >> 1];
    assign debug_mem0 = mem[0];

endmodule

// === FILE: sim/microcode_fill.hex ===
72800000   ; MOV DST.PAGE, 0
71800002   ; MOV DST.MODE, 2 (4bpp)
70800001   ; MOV DST.STEP, 1
6D800000   ; MOV DST.IDX, 0
6E80000A   ; MOV DST.PIX, 0xA
19801000   ; MOV FLUSH, ZERO
4000A000   ; HALT 0

// === FILE: sim/tb_alu.cpp ===
#include "Valu.h"
#include "verilated.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

static Valu* dut;
static int errors = 0;

static void tick() {
    dut->clk = 0; dut->eval();
    dut->clk = 1; dut->eval();
}

static void check(const char* name, uint16_t got, uint16_t exp) {
    if (got != exp) {
        printf("FAIL %s: got %04X exp %04X\n", name, got, exp);
        errors++;
    }
}

static void check_bit(const char* name, int got, int exp) {
    if (got != exp) {
        printf("FAIL %s: got %d exp %d\n", name, got, exp);
        errors++;
    }
}

static void do_op(uint8_t op, uint16_t a, uint16_t b, uint8_t c_in,
                  uint16_t exp_res, int exp_z, int exp_n, int exp_c, int exp_v,
                  const char* name) {
    dut->op = op;
    dut->a = a;
    dut->b = b;
    dut->c_in = c_in;
    dut->eval();
    check(name, dut->res, exp_res);
    check_bit((std::string(name) + ".z").c_str(), dut->z, exp_z);
    check_bit((std::string(name) + ".n").c_str(), dut->n, exp_n);
    check_bit((std::string(name) + ".c").c_str(), dut->c, exp_c);
    check_bit((std::string(name) + ".v").c_str(), dut->v, exp_v);
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    Verilated::commandArgs(argc, argv);
    dut = new Valu;

    dut->rst = 1; tick(); tick();
    dut->rst = 0;

    printf("=== ALU tests ===\n");

    // MOV (logic, fn=00, inv=0): res = b
    do_op(0b00'00'0, 0x1234, 0x5678, 0, 0x5678, 0, 0, 0, 0, "MOV");

    // MVN (logic, fn=00, inv=1): res = ~b
    do_op(0b00'00'1, 0x1234, 0x0F0F, 0, 0xF0F0, 0, 1, 0, 0, "MVN");

    // AND
    do_op(0b00'01'0, 0xFF00, 0x0FF0, 0, 0x0F00, 0, 0, 0, 0, "AND");

    // BIC (a & ~b)
    do_op(0b00'01'1, 0xFF00, 0x0FF0, 0, 0xF000, 0, 1, 0, 0, "BIC");

    // OR
    do_op(0b00'10'0, 0xFF00, 0x0FF0, 0, 0xFFF0, 0, 1, 0, 0, "OR");

    // XOR
    do_op(0b00'11'0, 0xFF00, 0x0FF0, 0, 0xF0F0, 0, 1, 0, 0, "XOR");

    // ADD
    do_op(0b01'00'0, 0x1000, 0x2000, 0, 0x3000, 0, 0, 0, 0, "ADD");

    // ADD carry: 0xFFFF + 1 = 0x0000, C=1
    do_op(0b01'00'0, 0xFFFF, 0x0001, 0, 0x0000, 1, 0, 1, 0, "ADD_C");

    // ADD overflow: 0x7FFF + 1 = 0x8000, N=1, V=1
    do_op(0b01'00'0, 0x7FFF, 0x0001, 0, 0x8000, 0, 1, 0, 1, "ADD_V");

    // ADC
    do_op(0b01'01'0, 0x1000, 0x2000, 1, 0x3001, 0, 0, 0, 0, "ADC");

    // SUB: 0x3000 - 0x1000 = 0x2000, C=1 (not borrow)
    do_op(0b01'10'1, 0x3000, 0x1000, 0, 0x2000, 0, 0, 1, 0, "SUB");

    // SUB borrow: 0x1000 - 0x2000 = 0xF000, C=0
    do_op(0b01'10'1, 0x1000, 0x2000, 0, 0xF000, 0, 1, 0, 0, "SUB_B");

    // SBC
    do_op(0b01'11'1, 0x3000, 0x1000, 1, 0x2000, 0, 0, 1, 0, "SBC");

    // SBC borrow: 0x3000 - 0x1000 - 1 = 0x1FFF
    do_op(0b01'11'1, 0x3000, 0x1000, 0, 0x1FFF, 0, 0, 1, 0, "SBC_B");

    // ROR 4
    do_op(0b10'00'0, 0x1234, 0x0004, 0, 0x4123, 0, 0, 0, 0, "ROR4");

    // SHR 4
    do_op(0b10'01'0, 0x1234, 0x0004, 0, 0x0123, 0, 0, 0, 0, "SHR4");

    // SAR 4: 0x8000 -> 0xF800
    do_op(0b10'10'0, 0x8000, 0x0004, 0, 0xF800, 0, 1, 0, 0, "SAR4");

    // MUL: 1000*1000 = 1,000,000 = 0xF4240, low 16 = 0x4240
    do_op(0b11'00'0, 1000, 1000, 0, 0x4240, 0, 0, 0, 0, "MUL");
    tick();  // mhi регистрируется
    check("MUL_MHI", dut->mhi, 0x000F);

    // TST
    do_op(0b11'10'0, 0xFF00, 0x0FF0, 0, 0xFF00, 0, 0, 0, 0, "TST");
    check_bit("TST.nowrite", dut->nowrite, 1);

    // CMP
    do_op(0b11'11'0, 0x3000, 0x1000, 0, 0x3000, 0, 0, 1, 0, "CMP");
    check_bit("CMP.nowrite", dut->nowrite, 1);

    printf("=== ALU tests done: %d errors ===\n", errors);
    delete dut;
    return errors ? 1 : 0;
}

// === FILE: sim/tb_gpu_cache.cpp ===
#include "Vgpu_cache.h"
#include "verilated.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>

static Vgpu_cache* dut;
static int errors = 0;

#define MEM_WORDS 32768
static uint16_t mem[MEM_WORDS];

static void tick() {
    dut->wb_ack_i = 0;
    dut->wb_dat_i = 0;
    if (dut->wb_cyc_o && dut->wb_stb_o) {
        uint32_t a = (dut->wb_adr_o >> 1) & (MEM_WORDS - 1);
        if (dut->wb_we_o) mem[a] = dut->wb_dat_o;
        else              dut->wb_dat_i = mem[a];
        dut->wb_ack_i = 1;
    }
    dut->eval();
    dut->clk = 1; dut->eval();
    dut->clk = 0; dut->eval();
}

static void check(const char* name, uint16_t got, uint16_t exp) {
    if (got != exp) {
        printf("FAIL %s: got %04X exp %04X\n", name, got, exp);
        errors++;
    }
}

static void check_bit(const char* name, int got, int exp) {
    if (got != exp) {
        printf("FAIL %s: got %d exp %d\n", name, got, exp);
        errors++;
    }
}

// access: сбросить *_done_r, выставить access, ждать access_done
static void do_access(uint8_t ch, uint16_t word, uint8_t we, uint16_t wdata,
                      uint16_t exp_rdata, const char* name) {
    dut->ch = ch;
    dut->word_in = word;
    dut->we = we;
    dut->wdata = wdata;

    // сброс access_done_r
    dut->access = 0;
    tick();

    // access
    dut->access = 1;
    int cycles = 0;
    while (!dut->access_done && cycles < 1000) { tick(); cycles++; }
    dut->access = 0;

    if (we == 0) check(name, dut->rdata, exp_rdata);
}

// flush: сбросить flush_done_r, выставить flush_en, ждать flush_done
static void do_flush(uint8_t ch) {
    dut->flush_ch = ch;

    // сброс flush_done_r
    dut->flush_en = 0;
    tick();

    // flush
    dut->flush_en = 1;
    int cycles = 0;
    while (!dut->flush_done && cycles < 1000) { tick(); cycles++; }
    dut->flush_en = 0;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    Verilated::commandArgs(argc, argv);
    dut = new Vgpu_cache;

    memset(mem, 0, sizeof(mem));
    dut->rst = 1; tick(); tick(); dut->rst = 0;

    // Отключаем prefetch/flush/page_we/access
    dut->prefetch_req = 0;
    dut->flush_en = 0; dut->flush_ch = 0;
    dut->page_we = 0; dut->page_in = 0;
    dut->access = 0; dut->we = 0;

    printf("=== gpu_cache tests ===\n");

    // ---- 1. page_we (тупой) ----
    dut->ch = 0; dut->page_in = 0; dut->page_we = 1; tick(); dut->page_we = 0;
    check("page0", dut->page_out, 0);

    // ---- 2. Read miss: ch0, word 0x10, mem[0x10]=0xABCD ----
    mem[0x10] = 0xABCD;
    do_access(0, 0x10, 0, 0, 0xABCD, "read_miss");
    check_bit("read_miss.hit", dut->hit, 1);

    // ---- 3. Read hit: ch0, word 0x10 ----
    do_access(0, 0x10, 0, 0, 0xABCD, "read_hit");

    // ---- 4. Write miss: ch1, word 0x20, wdata=0x1234 ----
    dut->ch = 1; dut->page_in = 0; dut->page_we = 1; tick(); dut->page_we = 0;
    mem[0x20] = 0x5555;
    do_access(1, 0x20, 1, 0x1234, 0, "write_miss");
    check("write_hit.mem_still", mem[0x20], 0x5555);

    // ---- 5. Write hit: ch1, word 0x20 ----
    do_access(1, 0x20, 1, 0x5678, 0, "write_hit");
    check("write_hit.mem_still", mem[0x20], 0x5555); // dirty, не сброшено

    // ---- 6. Flush ch1 ----
    do_flush(1);
    check("flush.mem", mem[0x20], 0x5678);

    // ---- 7. Read after flush (miss) ----
    do_access(1, 0x20, 0, 0, 0x5678, "read_after_flush");

    // ---- 8. Multi-channel ----
    mem[0x30] = 0x1111; mem[0x40] = 0x2222;
    dut->ch = 2; dut->page_in = 0; dut->page_we = 1; tick(); dut->page_we = 0;
    do_access(2, 0x30, 0, 0, 0x1111, "ch2_read");
    dut->ch = 3; dut->page_in = 0; dut->page_we = 1; tick(); dut->page_we = 0;
    do_access(3, 0x40, 0, 0, 0x2222, "ch3_read");

    // ---- 9. page_we при dirty: flush, потом page_we ----
    mem[0x50] = 0x9999;
    do_access(0, 0x50, 1, 0x7777, 0, "ch0_write_dirty");
    do_flush(0);
    check("page_dirty.mem", mem[0x50], 0x7777);

    dut->ch = 0; dut->page_in = 1; dut->page_we = 1; tick(); dut->page_we = 0;
    check("page1", dut->page_out, 1);

    printf("=== gpu_cache tests done: %d errors ===\n", errors);
    delete dut;
    return errors ? 1 : 0;
}

// === FILE: sim/tb_pixel_blender.cpp ===
#include "Vpixel_blender.h"
#include "verilated.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

static Vpixel_blender* dut;
static int errors = 0;

static void check(const char* name, uint16_t got, uint16_t exp) {
    if (got != exp) {
        printf("FAIL %s: got %04X exp %04X\n", name, got, exp);
        errors++;
    }
}

// one read: pixel_out = unpack(word_in)
static void do_read(uint8_t mode, uint8_t pos, uint16_t word,
                    uint16_t exp_pixel, const char* name) {
    dut->read = 1;
    dut->mode = mode;
    dut->pos = pos;
    dut->word_in = word;
    dut->pixel_in = 0;
    dut->eval();
    check((std::string(name) + ".pix").c_str(), dut->pixel_out, exp_pixel);
}

// one write: word_out = blend(word_in, pixel_in)
static void do_write(uint8_t mode, uint8_t pos, uint16_t word, uint16_t pixel,
                     uint16_t exp_word, const char* name) {
    dut->read = 0;
    dut->mode = mode;
    dut->pos = pos;
    dut->word_in = word;
    dut->pixel_in = pixel;
    dut->eval();
    check((std::string(name) + ".word").c_str(), dut->word_out, exp_word);
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    Verilated::commandArgs(argc, argv);
    dut = new Vpixel_blender;

    printf("=== pixel_blender tests ===\n");

    // ===== 4 bpp (mode=2) =====
    // word=0xABCD, pos=0 -> high nibble = 0xA
    do_read(2, 0, 0xABCD, 0x000A, "4bpp.p0.read");
    do_read(2, 1, 0xABCD, 0x000B, "4bpp.p1.read");
    do_read(2, 2, 0xABCD, 0x000C, "4bpp.p2.read");
    do_read(2, 3, 0xABCD, 0x000D, "4bpp.p3.read");

    // write pixel=0x5 at pos=0 -> 0x5BCD
    do_write(2, 0, 0xABCD, 0x0005, 0x5BCD, "4bpp.p0.write");
    do_write(2, 1, 0xABCD, 0x0005, 0xA5CD, "4bpp.p1.write");
    do_write(2, 2, 0xABCD, 0x0005, 0xAB5D, "4bpp.p2.write");
    do_write(2, 3, 0xABCD, 0x0005, 0xABC5, "4bpp.p3.write");

    // ===== 8 bpp (mode=3) =====
    // word=0xABCD, pos=0 -> high byte = 0xAB
    do_read(3, 0, 0xABCD, 0x00AB, "8bpp.p0.read");
    do_read(3, 1, 0xABCD, 0x00CD, "8bpp.p1.read");

    // write pixel=0x12 at pos=0 -> 0x12CD
    do_write(3, 0, 0xABCD, 0x0012, 0x12CD, "8bpp.p0.write");
    do_write(3, 1, 0xABCD, 0x0012, 0xAB12, "8bpp.p1.write");

    // ===== 1 bpp (mode=0) =====
    // word=0x8000, pos=0 -> bit 15 = 1
    do_read(0, 0, 0x8000, 0x0001, "1bpp.p0.read");
    do_read(0, 15, 0x0001, 0x0001, "1bpp.p15.read");
    do_read(0, 0, 0x0000, 0x0000, "1bpp.p0.read.zero");

    // 1 bpp: write forbidden -> word_out = word_in
    do_write(0, 0, 0x8000, 0x0000, 0x8000, "1bpp.p0.write_forbidden");
    do_write(0, 15, 0x0001, 0x0000, 0x0001, "1bpp.p15.write_forbidden");

    // ===== 2 bpp (mode=1) =====
    // word=0xE400, pos=0 -> 2 bits at 15:14 = 0b11 = 3
    do_read(1, 0, 0xE400, 0x0003, "2bpp.p0.read");
    do_read(1, 3, 0xE400, 0x0000, "2bpp.p3.read");

    // 2 bpp: write forbidden
    do_write(1, 0, 0xE400, 0x0000, 0xE400, "2bpp.p0.write_forbidden");

    // ===== 16 bpp (mode=4) =====
    do_read(4, 0, 0x1234, 0x1234, "16bpp.read");
    do_write(4, 0, 0xABCD, 0x1234, 0x1234, "16bpp.write");

    // ===== PASS_LO8 (mode=5) =====
    do_read(5, 0, 0xABCD, 0x00CD, "pass_lo8.read");
    do_write(5, 0, 0xABCD, 0x0012, 0xAB12, "pass_lo8.write");

    // ===== PASS_HI8 (mode=6) =====
    do_read(6, 0, 0xABCD, 0x00AB, "pass_hi8.read");
    do_write(6, 0, 0xABCD, 0x0012, 0x12CD, "pass_hi8.write");

    // ===== PASS16 (mode=7) =====
    do_read(7, 0, 0x1234, 0x1234, "pass16.read");
    do_write(7, 0, 0xABCD, 0x1234, 0x1234, "pass16.write");

    printf("=== pixel_blender tests done: %d errors ===\n", errors);
    delete dut;
    return errors ? 1 : 0;
}

// === FILE: sim/tb_pixel_buffer_wrapper.sv ===
`timescale 1ns/1ps
// Wrapper: exposes pixel_buffer internals for C++ testbench.
module tb_pixel_buffer_wrapper (
    input  logic clk,
    input  logic rst,
    input  logic [1:0]  ch,
    input  logic [23:0] addr24,
    output logic        hit,
    output logic [15:0] rdata,
    input  logic        fill_en,
    input  logic [15:0] fill_data,
    input  logic        we,
    input  logic [15:0] wdata,
    input  logic        set_page_en,
    input  logic [7:0]  set_page_val,
    input  logic        flush_en,
    output logic        wb_req,
    output logic [23:0] wb_addr,
    output logic [15:0] wb_data,
    input  logic        wb_ack,
    output logic        error,
    // debug: expose internals
    output logic        dirty1,
    output logic [15:0] data1
);
    pixel_buffer dut (
        .clk(clk), .rst(rst),
        .ch(ch), .addr24(addr24),
        .hit(hit), .rdata(rdata),
        .fill_en(fill_en), .fill_data(fill_data),
        .we(we), .wdata(wdata),
        .set_page_en(set_page_en), .set_page_val(set_page_val),
        .flush_en(flush_en),
        .wb_req(wb_req), .wb_addr(wb_addr), .wb_data(wb_data),
        .wb_ack(wb_ack),
        .error(error)
    );
    assign dirty1 = dut.dirty[1];
    assign data1  = dut.data[1];
endmodule

// === FILE: sim/tb_pixel_engine.cpp ===
#include "Vpixel_engine.h"
#include "verilated.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

static Vpixel_engine* dut;
static int errors = 0;

static void tick() {
    dut->clk = 0; dut->eval();
    dut->clk = 1; dut->eval();
    dut->clk = 0; dut->eval();
}

static void check(const char* name, uint16_t got, uint16_t exp) {
    if (got != exp) {
        printf("FAIL %s: got %04X exp %04X\n", name, got, exp);
        errors++;
    }
}

static void check_bit(const char* name, int got, int exp) {
    if (got != exp) {
        printf("FAIL %s: got %d exp %d\n", name, got, exp);
        errors++;
    }
}

// Записать IDX (с опциональным IDXH)
static void set_idx(uint8_t ch, uint16_t idx, uint8_t idxh, uint8_t mode) {
    dut->ch = ch;
    dut->mode_we = 1; dut->mode_in = mode;
    dut->idxh_we = 0; dut->idx_we = 0; dut->step_we = 0;
    dut->access = 0;
    tick();

    if (idxh != 0xFF) {
        dut->idxh_we = 1; dut->idxh_in = idxh & 7;
        dut->mode_we = 0;
        tick();
    }

    dut->idx_we = 1; dut->idx_in = idx;
    dut->idxh_we = 0;
    tick();

    dut->idx_we = 0;
    dut->eval();
}

static void set_step(uint8_t ch, uint16_t step) {
    dut->ch = ch;
    dut->step_we = 1; dut->step_in = step;
    dut->mode_we = 0; dut->idx_we = 0; dut->idxh_we = 0; dut->access = 0;
    tick();
    dut->step_we = 0;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    Verilated::commandArgs(argc, argv);
    dut = new Vpixel_engine;

    dut->rst = 1; tick(); tick();
    dut->rst = 0;

    printf("=== pixel_engine tests ===\n");

    // 16 bpp (mode=4, k=0): IDX=0x1234 -> word=0x1234, pos=0
    set_idx(0, 0x1234, 0, 4);
    check("16bpp.IDX1234.word", dut->word_out, 0x1234);
    check("16bpp.IDX1234.pos",  dut->pos, 0);

    // 8 bpp (mode=3, k=1): IDX=0x1234 -> word=0x91A, pos=0
    set_idx(0, 0x1234, 0, 3);
    check("8bpp.IDX1234.word", dut->word_out, 0x091A);
    check("8bpp.IDX1234.pos",  dut->pos, 0);

    // 8 bpp: IDX=0x1235 -> word=0x91A, pos=1
    set_idx(0, 0x1235, 0, 3);
    check("8bpp.IDX1235.word", dut->word_out, 0x091A);
    check("8bpp.IDX1235.pos",  dut->pos, 1);

    // 4 bpp (mode=2, k=2): IDX=0x1234 -> word=0x48D, pos=0
    set_idx(0, 0x1234, 0, 2);
    check("4bpp.IDX1234.word", dut->word_out, 0x048D);
    check("4bpp.IDX1234.pos",  dut->pos, 0);

    // 4 bpp: IDX=0x1235 -> word=0x48D, pos=1
    set_idx(0, 0x1235, 0, 2);
    check("4bpp.IDX1235.word", dut->word_out, 0x048D);
    check("4bpp.IDX1235.pos",  dut->pos, 1);

    // 4 bpp: IDX=0x1236 -> word=0x48D, pos=2
    set_idx(0, 0x1236, 0, 2);
    check("4bpp.IDX1236.word", dut->word_out, 0x048D);
    check("4bpp.IDX1236.pos",  dut->pos, 2);

    // 4 bpp: IDX=0x1237 -> word=0x48D, pos=3
    set_idx(0, 0x1237, 0, 2);
    check("4bpp.IDX1237.word", dut->word_out, 0x048D);
    check("4bpp.IDX1237.pos",  dut->pos, 3);

    // 1 bpp (mode=0, k=4): IDX=0x1234 -> word=0x123, pos=4
    set_idx(0, 0x1234, 0, 0);
    check("1bpp.IDX1234.word", dut->word_out, 0x0123);
    check("1bpp.IDX1234.pos",  dut->pos, 4);

    // 1 bpp: IDX=0x123F -> word=0x123, pos=15
    set_idx(0, 0x123F, 0, 0);
    check("1bpp.IDX123F.word", dut->word_out, 0x0123);
    check("1bpp.IDX123F.pos",  dut->pos, 15);

    // IDXH: IDX=0x1234, IDXH=1 -> IDX = 0x11234
    // 16 bpp: word = 0x11234, pos = 0 (но word_out 15 бит -> 0x1234? Нет, 0x11234 > 0x7FFF)
    // Проверим с 1 bpp: IDX=0x1234, IDXH=1 -> IDX = 0x11234, word = 0x1123, pos = 4
    set_idx(0, 0x1234, 1, 0);
    check("IDXH.word", dut->word_out, 0x1123);
    check("IDXH.pos",  dut->pos, 4);

    // IDXH обнуляется после IDX: следующий IDX=0x1234 (без IDXH) -> IDX = 0x1234
    set_idx(0, 0x1234, 0xFF, 0);   // 0xFF = не писать IDXH
    check("IDXH.reset.word", dut->word_out, 0x0123);
    check("IDXH.reset.pos",  dut->pos, 4);

    // STEP: 4 bpp, IDX=0x1234, STEP=1 -> после access IDX=0x1235
    set_idx(0, 0x1234, 0, 2);
    set_step(0, 0x10);
    dut->access = 1; tick(); dut->access = 0;
    check("STEP1.word", dut->word_out, 0x048D);
    check("STEP1.pos",  dut->pos, 1);

    // STEP: 4 bpp, IDX=0x1237, STEP=1 -> после access IDX=0x1238 -> word=0x48E, pos=0
    set_idx(0, 0x1237, 0, 2);
    set_step(0, 0x10);
    dut->access = 1; tick(); dut->access = 0;
    check("STEP2.word", dut->word_out, 0x048E);
    check("STEP2.pos",  dut->pos, 0);

    // STEP: 16 bpp, IDX=0x1234, STEP=8 (8 пикселей = 8 слов) -> IDX=0x123C
    set_idx(0, 0x1234, 0, 4);
    set_step(0, 0x80);
    dut->access = 1; tick(); dut->access = 0;
    check("STEP16.word", dut->word_out, 0x123C);
    check("STEP16.pos",  dut->pos, 0);

    printf("=== pixel_engine tests done: %d errors ===\n", errors);
    delete dut;
    return errors ? 1 : 0;
}

// === FILE: sim/tb_sequencer.cpp ===
#include "Vsequencer.h"
#include "verilated.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

static Vsequencer* dut;
static int errors = 0;

static void tick() {
    dut->clk = 0; dut->eval();
    dut->clk = 1; dut->eval();
    dut->clk = 0; dut->eval();
}

static void check(const char* name, uint16_t got, uint16_t exp) {
    if (got != exp) {
        printf("FAIL %s: got %04X exp %04X\n", name, got, exp);
        errors++;
    }
}

static void check_bit(const char* name, int got, int exp) {
    if (got != exp) {
        printf("FAIL %s: got %d exp %d\n", name, got, exp);
        errors++;
    }
}

// do one instruction: set inputs, tick
static void do_insn(uint8_t imm_class, uint8_t reg_op, uint8_t cond, uint8_t l,
                    uint16_t imm12, uint8_t z, uint8_t n, uint8_t c, uint8_t v,
                    uint16_t jmpr_target) {
    dut->imm_class  = imm_class;
    dut->reg_op     = reg_op;
    dut->cond       = cond;
    dut->l          = l;
    dut->imm12      = imm12;
    dut->z          = z;
    dut->n          = n;
    dut->c          = c;
    dut->v          = v;
    dut->jmpr_target = jmpr_target;
    dut->start      = 0;
    dut->stall      = 0;
    dut->loop_cnt_we = 0;
    dut->loop_tgt_we = 0;
    tick();
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    Verilated::commandArgs(argc, argv);
    dut = new Vsequencer;

    // reset
    dut->rst = 1; tick(); tick();
    dut->rst = 0;

    // start: PC=0, halted=0
    dut->start = 1; tick();
    dut->start = 0;
    check_bit("start.halted", dut->halted, 0);
    check("start.pc", dut->pc, 0);

    printf("=== sequencer tests ===\n");

    // JMP: PC -> imm12
    do_insn(0b10, 1, 0, 0, 0x100, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    check("JMP.pc", dut->pc, 0x100);

    // JMP not taken (cond=EQ, z=0): PC -> PC+1
    do_insn(0b10, 1, 1, 0, 0x100, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    check("JMP_not_taken.pc", dut->pc, 0x101);

    // CALL: SHADOW = {flags, PC+1}, PC -> imm12
    // flags: v=1, c=0, n=1, z=0 -> 1010
    do_insn(0b10, 2, 0, 0, 0x200, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0);
    check("CALL.pc", dut->pc, 0x200);
    // shadow = {v, c, n, z, pc+1} = {1, 0, 1, 0, 0x102} = 0xA102
    check("CALL.shadow", dut->shadow, 0xA102);

    // RET: PC -> SHADOW[11:0]
    do_insn(0b10, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    check("RET.pc", dut->pc, 0x102);

    // JMPR: PC -> jmpr_target
    do_insn(0b10, 4, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x300);
    check("JMPR.pc", dut->pc, 0x300);

    // HALT 0: halted=1
    do_insn(0b10, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    check_bit("HALT0.halted", dut->halted, 1);

    // restart
    dut->start = 1; tick(); dut->start = 0;
    check_bit("restart.halted", dut->halted, 0);
    check("restart.pc", dut->pc, 0);

    // HALT X (X=0x55): error=1, error_code=0x55
    do_insn(0b10, 5, 0, 0, 0x55, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    check_bit("HALT55.error", dut->error, 1);
    check("HALT55.error_code", dut->error_code, 0x55);

    // restart
    dut->start = 1; tick(); dut->start = 0;
    check_bit("restart2.halted", dut->halted, 0);

    // IRQ: irq_pending=1, irq_code=0x10
    do_insn(0b10, 6, 0, 0, 0x10, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    check_bit("IRQ.irq_pending", dut->irq_pending, 1);
    check("IRQ.irq_code", dut->irq_code, 0x10);

    // ===== LOOP tests =====
    // Записываем CNT=3, TGT=0x400 через порты
    dut->loop_cnt_we = 1; dut->loop_cnt_in = 3;
    dut->loop_tgt_we = 1; dut->loop_tgt_in = 0x400;
    dut->start = 0; dut->stall = 0;
    tick();
    dut->loop_cnt_we = 0; dut->loop_tgt_we = 0;
    check("LOOP.cnt_init", dut->loop_cnt, 3);
    check("LOOP.tgt_init", dut->loop_tgt, 0x400);

    // L=1, CNT=3 > 1: PC -> LOOP.TGT (0x400), CNT--
    do_insn(0b00, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    check("LOOP1.pc", dut->pc, 0x400);
    check("LOOP1.cnt", dut->loop_cnt, 2);

    // L=1, CNT=2 > 1: PC -> LOOP.TGT (0x400), CNT--
    do_insn(0b00, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    check("LOOP2.pc", dut->pc, 0x400);
    check("LOOP2.cnt", dut->loop_cnt, 1);

    // L=1, CNT=1: PC -> PC+1 (0x401), CNT не меняется
    do_insn(0b00, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    check("LOOP3.pc", dut->pc, 0x401);
    check("LOOP3.cnt", dut->loop_cnt, 1);

    // L=1, CNT=5, взятый JMP: PC -> JMP target, CNT не меняется
    dut->loop_cnt_we = 1; dut->loop_cnt_in = 5;
    dut->start = 0; dut->stall = 0;
    tick();
    dut->loop_cnt_we = 0;
    do_insn(0b10, 1, 0, 1, 0x500, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);  // CTRL JMP, L=1
    check("LOOP_JMP.pc", dut->pc, 0x500);
    check("LOOP_JMP.cnt", dut->loop_cnt, 5);

    // ===== STALL test =====
    uint16_t pc_before = dut->pc;
    dut->imm_class = 0b00; dut->reg_op = 0; dut->cond = 0; dut->l = 0;
    dut->imm12 = 0; dut->z = 0; dut->n = 0; dut->c = 0; dut->v = 0;
    dut->jmpr_target = 0; dut->start = 0; dut->stall = 1;
    dut->loop_cnt_we = 0; dut->loop_tgt_we = 0;
    tick();
    dut->stall = 0;
    check("STALL.pc", dut->pc, pc_before);

    printf("=== sequencer tests done: %d errors ===\n", errors);
    delete dut;
    return errors ? 1 : 0;
}

// === FILE: sim/tb_top_wrapper.sv ===
`timescale 1ns/1ps
`default_nettype none

module tb_top_wrapper (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst,
    output logic        halted,
    output logic        error,
    input  logic        start,
    input  logic        rom_we,
    input  logic [11:0] rom_addr,
    input  logic [31:0] rom_wdata,
    output logic        wb_cyc,
    output logic        wb_stb,
    output logic        wb_we,
    output logic [23:0] wb_adr,
    output logic [15:0] wb_dat_o,
    input  logic [15:0] wb_dat_i,
    input  logic        wb_ack
);
    top u_top (
        .clk(clk), .rst(rst),
        .halted(halted), .error(error),
        .start(start),
        .rom_we(rom_we), .rom_addr(rom_addr), .rom_wdata(rom_wdata),
        .wb_cyc(wb_cyc), .wb_stb(wb_stb), .wb_we(wb_we),
        .wb_adr(wb_adr), .wb_dat_o(wb_dat_o),
        .wb_dat_i(wb_dat_i), .wb_ack(wb_ack)
    );
endmodule

/* stb_image - v2.32 - public domain image loader - http://nothings.org/stb
                                  no warranty implied; use at your own risk

   == SECURITY NOTE ==

   If security is a priority, consider using Wuffs instead:
     https://github.com/google/wuffs-mirror-release-c
   v0.3 is the current stable version, but v0.4 includes an stb_image-compatible
   API using #define WUFFS_CONFIG__ENABLE_DROP_IN_REPLACEMENT__STB

   Limitations:
     - Wuffs is not public domain, but is available under MIT and Apache licenses.
     - Wuffs supports a different set of file formats.
     - Wuffs source file 1.8 MB (v0.3) or 3.5 MB (v0.4 as of 2026-11-01),
       whereas stb_image is about 0.3 MB.

   == stb_image ==

   Do this:
      #define STB_IMAGE_IMPLEMENTATION
   before you include this file in *one* C or C++ file to create the implementation.

   // i.e. it should look like this:
   #include ...
   #include ...
   #include ...
   #define STB_IMAGE_IMPLEMENTATION
   #include "stb_image.h"

   You can #define STBI_ASSERT(x) before the #include to avoid using assert.h.
   And #define STBI_MALLOC, STBI_REALLOC, and STBI_FREE to avoid using malloc,realloc,free

   STBI_REALLOC_SIZED is an alternative to STBI_REALLOC that is also passed the previously
   alocated size, which can be helpful in certain constrained environments.

   QUICK NOTES:
      Primarily of interest to game developers and other people who can
          avoid problematic images and only need the trivial interface

      JPEG baseline & progressive (12 bpc/arithmetic not supported, same as stock IJG lib)
      PNG 1/2/4/8/16-bit-per-channel

      TGA (not sure what subset, if a subset)
      BMP non-1bpp, non-RLE
      PSD (composited view only, no extra channels, 8/16 bit-per-channel)

      GIF (*comp always reports as 4-channel)
      HDR (radiance rgbE format)
      PNM (PPM and PGM binary only)

      Animated GIF still needs a proper API, but here's one way to do it:
          http://gist.github.com/urraka/685d9a6340b26b830d49

      - decode from memory or through FILE (define STBI_NO_STDIO to remove code)
      - decode from arbitrary I/O callbacks
      - SIMD acceleration on x86/x64 (SSE2) and ARM (NEON)

   Full documentation under "DOCUMENTATION" below.

#ifndef STBI_INCLUDE_STB_IMAGE_H
#define STBI_INCLUDE_STB_IMAGE_H

// DOCUMENTATION
//
// Limitations:
//    - no 12-bit-per-channel JPEG
//    - no JPEGs with arithmetic coding
//    - GIF always returns *comp=4
//
// Basic usage (see HDR discussion below for HDR usage):
//    int x,y,n;
//    unsigned char *data = stbi_load(filename, &x, &y, &n, 0);
//    // ... process data if not NULL ...
//    // ... x = width, y = height, n = # 8-bit components per pixel ...
//    // ... replace '0' with '1'..'4' to force that many components per pixel
//    // ... but 'n' will always be the number that it would have been if you said 0
//    stbi_image_free(data);
//
// Standard parameters:
//    int *x                 -- outputs image width in pixels
//    int *y                 -- outputs image height in pixels
//    int *channels_in_file  -- outputs # of image components in image file
//    int desired_channels   -- if non-zero, # of image components requested in result
//
// The return value from an image loader is an 'unsigned char *' which points
// to the pixel data, or NULL on an allocation failure or if the image is
// corrupt or invalid. The pixel data consists of *y scanlines of *x pixels,
// with each pixel consisting of N interleaved 8-bit components; the first
// pixel pointed to is top-left-most in the image. There is no padding between
// image scanlines or between pixels, regardless of format. The number of
// components N is 'desired_channels' if desired_channels is non-zero, or
// *channels_in_file otherwise. If desired_channels is non-zero,
// *channels_in_file has the number of components that _would_ have been
// output otherwise. E.g. if you set desired_channels to 4, you will always
// get RGBA output, but you can check *channels_in_file to see if it's trivially
// opaque because e.g. there were only 3 channels in the source image.
//
// An output image with N components has the following components interleaved
// in this order in each pixel:
//
//     N=#comp     components
//       1           grey
//       2           grey, alpha
//       3           red, green, blue
//       4           red, green, blue, alpha
//
// If image loading fails for any reason, the return value will be NULL,
// and *x, *y, *channels_in_file will be unchanged. The function
// stbi_failure_reason() can be queried for an extremely brief, end-user
// unfriendly explanation of why the load failed. Define STBI_NO_FAILURE_STRINGS
// to avoid compiling these strings at all, and STBI_FAILURE_USERMSG to get slightly
// more user-friendly ones.
//
// Paletted PNG, BMP, GIF, and PIC images are automatically depalettized.
//
// To query the width, height and component count of an image without having to
// decode the full file, you can use the stbi_info family of functions:
//
//   int x,y,n,ok;
//   ok = stbi_info(filename, &x, &y, &n);
//   // returns ok=1 and sets x, y, n if image is a supported format,
//   // 0 otherwise.
//
// The stbi_info2 family provides the same information in struct format, plus
// some additional flags.
//
// Note that stb_image pervasively uses ints in its public API for sizes,
// including sizes of memory buffers. This is now part of the API and thus
// hard to change without causing breakage. As a result, the various image
// loaders all have certain limits on image size; these differ somewhat
// by format but generally boil down to either just under 2GB or just under
// 1GB. When the decoded image would be larger than this, stb_image decoding
// will fail.
//
// Additionally, stb_image will reject image files that have any of their
// dimensions set to a larger value than the configurable STBI_MAX_DIMENSIONS,
// which defaults to 2**24 = 16777216 pixels. Due to the above memory limit,
// the only way to have an image with such dimensions load correctly
// is for it to have a rather extreme aspect ratio. Either way, the
// assumption here is that such larger images are likely to be malformed
// or malicious. If you do need to load an image with individual dimensions
// larger than that, and it still fits in the overall size limit, you can
// #define STBI_MAX_DIMENSIONS on your own to be something larger.
//
// ===========================================================================
//
// UNICODE:
//
//   If compiling for Windows and you wish to use Unicode filenames, compile
//   with
//       #define STBI_WINDOWS_UTF8
//   and pass utf8-encoded filenames. Call stbi_convert_wchar_to_utf8 to convert
//   Windows wchar_t filenames to utf8.
//
// ===========================================================================
//
// Philosophy
//
// stb libraries are designed with the following priorities:
//
//    1. easy to use
//    2. easy to maintain
//    3. good performance
//
// Sometimes I let "good performance" creep up in priority over "easy to maintain",
// and for best performance I may provide less-easy-to-use APIs that give higher
// performance, in addition to the easy-to-use ones. Nevertheless, it's important
// to keep in mind that from the standpoint of you, a client of this library,
// all you care about is #1 and #3, and stb libraries DO NOT emphasize #3 above all.
//
// Some secondary priorities arise directly from the first two, some of which
// provide more explicit reasons why performance can't be emphasized.
//
//    - Portable ("ease of use")
//    - Small source code footprint ("easy to maintain")
//    - No dependencies ("ease of use")
//
// ===========================================================================
//
// I/O callbacks
//
// I/O callbacks allow you to read from arbitrary sources, like packaged
// files or some other source. Data read from callbacks are processed
// through a small internal buffer (currently 128 bytes) to try to reduce
// overhead.
//
// The three functions you must define are "read" (reads some bytes of data),
// "skip" (skips some bytes of data), "eof" (reports if the stream is at the end).
//
// ===========================================================================
//
// SIMD support
//
// The JPEG decoder will try to automatically use SIMD kernels on x86 when
// supported by the compiler. For ARM Neon support, you must explicitly
// request it.
//
// (The old do-it-yourself SIMD API is no longer supported in the current
// code.)
//
// On x86, SSE2 will automatically be used when available based on a run-time
// test; if not, the generic C versions are used as a fall-back. On ARM targets,
// the typical path is to have separate builds for NEON and non-NEON devices
// (at least this is true for iOS and Android). Therefore, the NEON support is
// toggled by a build flag: define STBI_NEON to get NEON loops.
//
// If for some reason you do not want to use any of SIMD code, or if
// you have issues compiling it, you can disable it entirely by
// defining STBI_NO_SIMD.
//
// On 32-bit MinGW, SSE2 support is disabled by default. You can allow it
// by defining STBI_MINGW_ENABLE_SSE2, but this comes with caveats due to
// compiler ABI issues. Search for STBI_MINGW_ENABLE_SSE2 further down in this
// file for details.
//
// ===========================================================================
//
// HDR image support   (disable by defining STBI_NO_HDR)
//
// stb_image supports loading HDR images in general, and currently the Radiance
// .HDR file format specifically. You can still load any file through the existing
// interface; if you attempt to load an HDR file, it will be automatically remapped
// to LDR, assuming gamma 2.2 and an arbitrary scale factor defaulting to 1;
// both of these constants can be reconfigured through this interface:
//
//     stbi_hdr_to_ldr_gamma(2.2f);
//     stbi_hdr_to_ldr_scale(1.0f);
//
// (note, do not use _inverse_ constants; stbi_image will invert them
// appropriately).
//
// Additionally, there is a new, parallel interface for loading files as
// (linear) floats to preserve the full dynamic range:
//
//    float *data = stbi_loadf(filename, &x, &y, &n, 0);
//
// If you load LDR images through this interface, those images will
// be promoted to floating point values, run through the inverse of
// constants corresponding to the above:
//
//     stbi_ldr_to_hdr_scale(1.0f);
//     stbi_ldr_to_hdr_gamma(2.2f);
//
// Finally, given a filename (or an open file or memory block--see header
// file for details) containing image data, you can query for the "most
// appropriate" interface to use (that is, whether the image is HDR or
// not), using:
//
//     stbi_is_hdr(char *filename);
//
// If you also want to query other image details at the same time:
//
//     stbi_info_res r = stbi_info2(filename);
//     if (r.type != STBI_type_unknown && r.is_hdr) {
//        // ...
//     }
//
// ===========================================================================
//
// iPhone PNG support:
//
// iPhone-formatted PNGs, also known as CgBI PNGs, are supported. Unlike
// standard PNGs, these store colors in BGR/BGRA order with premultiplied alpha.
//
// By default, stb_image will load the colors in the same format they were
// stored in. If you need to know which kind of PNG was loaded, and thus the
// color format, call one of the stbi_info2 functions and check is_iphone_png.
//
// Alternatively, if you want stb_image to convert the color order to RGB/RGBA,
// call stbi_convert_iphone_png_to_rgb(1).
//
// Call stbi_set_unpremultiply_on_load(1) as well to force a divide per pixel
// pixel to remove any premultiplied alpha. Note that this currently only works
// when color order conversion is also in use.
//
// ===========================================================================
//
// ADDITIONAL CONFIGURATION
//
//  - You can #define STB_IMAGE_STATIC to cause all STB image functions to
//    get declared with static linkage. This is useful when you want to
//    write an image loader wrapper without the STB functions leaking into
//    the global namespace, or when a project contains (for whatever reason)
//    multiple versions of stb_image.
//
//  - You can suppress implementation of any of the decoders to reduce
//    your code footprint by #defining one or more of the following
//    symbols before creating the implementation.
//
//        STBI_NO_JPEG
//        STBI_NO_PNG
//        STBI_NO_BMP
//        STBI_NO_PSD
//        STBI_NO_TGA
//        STBI_NO_GIF
//        STBI_NO_HDR
//        STBI_NO_PNM   (.ppm and .pgm)
//
//  - You can request *only* certain decoders and suppress all other ones
//    (this will be more forward-compatible, as addition of new decoders
//    doesn't require you to disable them explicitly):
//
//        STBI_ONLY_JPEG
//        STBI_ONLY_PNG
//        STBI_ONLY_BMP
//        STBI_ONLY_PSD
//        STBI_ONLY_TGA
//        STBI_ONLY_GIF
//        STBI_ONLY_HDR
//        STBI_ONLY_PNM   (.ppm and .pgm)
//
//  - Setting STBI_NO_LINEAR will remove the stbi_loadf family of functions
//    that returns pixel data as floats.
//
//  - If you use STBI_NO_PNG (or _ONLY_ without PNG), and you still
//    want the zlib decoder to be available, #define STBI_SUPPORT_ZLIB
//
//  - If you define STBI_MAX_DIMENSIONS, stb_image will reject images greater
//    than that size (in either width or height) without further processing.
//    This is to let programs in the wild set an upper bound to prevent
//    denial-of-service attacks on untrusted data, as one could generate a
//    valid image of gigantic dimensions and force stb_image to allocate a
//    huge block of memory and spend disproportionate time decoding it. By
//    default this is set to (1 << 24), which is 16777216, but that's still
//    very big.

#ifndef STBI_NO_STDIO
#include <stdio.h>
#endif // STBI_NO_STDIO

#define STBI_VERSION 1

enum
{
   STBI_default = 0, // only used for desired_channels

   STBI_grey       = 1,
   STBI_grey_alpha = 2,
   STBI_rgb        = 3,
   STBI_rgb_alpha  = 4
};

enum
{
   STBI_type_unsupported = 0, // image type

   STBI_type_jpeg,
   STBI_type_png,
   STBI_type_gif,
   STBI_type_bmp,
   STBI_type_psd,
   STBI_type_pnm,
   STBI_type_hdr,
   STBI_type_tga,
};

//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
//
// PRIMARY API - works on images of any type
//

//
// load image by filename, open file, or memory buffer
//

typedef struct
{
   int      (*read)  (void *user,char *data,int size);   // fill 'data' with 'size' bytes.  return number of bytes actually read
   void     (*skip)  (void *user,int n);                 // skip the next 'n' bytes, or 'unget' the last -n bytes if negative
   int      (*eof)   (void *user);                       // returns nonzero if we are at end of file/data
} stbi_io_callbacks;

// 8-bits-per-channel interface
//

#define STBI__X86_TARGET
#endif

#if defined(__GNUC__) && defined(STBI__X86_TARGET) && !defined(__SSE2__) && !defined(STBI_NO_SIMD)
// gcc doesn't support sse2 intrinsics unless you compile with -msse2,
// which in turn means it gets to use SSE2 everywhere. This is unfortunate,
// but previous attempts to provide the SSE2 functions with runtime
// detection caused numerous issues. The way architecture extensions are
// exposed in GCC/Clang is, sadly, not really suited for one-file libs.
// New behavior: if compiled with -msse2, we use SSE2 without any
// detection; if not, we don't use it at all.
#define STBI_NO_SIMD
#endif

#if defined(__MINGW32__) && defined(STBI__X86_TARGET) && !defined(STBI_MINGW_ENABLE_SSE2) && !defined(STBI_NO_SIMD)
// Note that __MINGW32__ doesn't actually mean 32-bit, so we have to avoid STBI__X64_TARGET
//
// 32-bit MinGW wants ESP to be 16-byte aligned, but this is not in the
// Windows ABI and VC++ as well as Windows DLLs don't maintain that invariant.
// As a result, enabling SSE2 on 32-bit MinGW is dangerous when not
// simultaneously enabling "-mstackrealign".
//
// See https://github.com/nothings/stb/issues/81 for more information.
//
// So default to no SSE2 on 32-bit MinGW. If you've read this far and added
// -mstackrealign to your build settings, feel free to #define STBI_MINGW_ENABLE_SSE2.
#define STBI_NO_SIMD
#endif

#if !defined(STBI_NO_SIMD) && (defined(STBI__X86_TARGET) || defined(STBI__X64_TARGET))
#define STBI__SSE2
#include <emmintrin.h>

#ifdef _MSC_VER

#if _MSC_VER >= 1400  // not VC6
#include <intrin.h> // __cpuid
static int stbi__cpuid3(void)
{
   int info[4];
   __cpuid(info,1);
   return info[3];
}
#else
static int stbi__cpuid3(void)
{
   int res;
   __asm {
      mov  eax,1
      cpuid
      mov  res,edx
   }
   return res;
}
#endif

#define STBI__SIMD_ALIGN(type, name) __declspec(align(16)) type name

#if !defined(STBI_NO_JPEG) && defined(STBI__SSE2)
static int stbi__sse2_available(void)
{
   int info3 = stbi__cpuid3();
   return ((info3 >> 26) & 1) != 0;
}
#endif

#else // assume GCC-style if not VC++
#define STBI__SIMD_ALIGN(type, name) type name __attribute__((aligned(16)))

#if !defined(STBI_NO_JPEG) && defined(STBI__SSE2)
static int stbi__sse2_available(void)
{
   // If we're even attempting to compile this on GCC/Clang, that means
   // -msse2 is on, which means the compiler is allowed to use SSE2
   // instructions at will, and so are we.
   return 1;
}
#endif

#endif
#endif

///////////////////////////////////////////////
//
//  stbi__context struct and start_xxx functions

// stbi__context structure is our basic context used by all images, so it
// contains all the IO context, plus some basic image information
typedef struct
{
   stbi__uint32 img_x, img_y;
   int img_n, img_out_n;

   stbi_io_callbacks io;
   void *io_user_data;

   int read_from_callbacks;
   int buflen;
   stbi_uc buffer_start[128];
   int callback_already_read;

   stbi_uc *img_buffer, *img_buffer_end;
   stbi_uc *img_buffer_original, *img_buffer_original_end;
} stbi__context;


static void stbi__refill_buffer(stbi__context *s);

// initialize a memory-decode context
static void stbi__start_mem(stbi__context *s, stbi_uc const *buffer, int len)
{
   s->io.read = NULL;
   s->read_from_callbacks = 0;
   s->callback_already_read = 0;
   s->img_buffer = s->img_buffer_original = (stbi_uc *) buffer;
   s->img_buffer_end = s->img_buffer_original_end = (stbi_uc *) buffer+len;
}

// initialize a callback-based context
static void stbi__start_callbacks(stbi__context *s, stbi_io_callbacks *c, void *user)
{
   s->io = *c;
   s->io_user_data = user;
   s->buflen = sizeof(s->buffer_start);
   s->read_from_callbacks = 1;
   s->callback_already_read = 0;
   s->img_buffer = s->img_buffer_original = s->buffer_start;
   stbi__refill_buffer(s);
   s->img_buffer_original_end = s->img_buffer_end;
}

static void stbi__stop(stbi__context *s)
{
   if (s->img_buffer != s->img_buffer_end && s->io.read && s->io.skip) {
      // there are remaining characters in the IO buffer, skip back to the actual position we finished at
      (s->io.skip)(s->io_user_data, -(int) (s->img_buffer_end - s->img_buffer));
   }
}

#ifndef STBI_NO_STDIO

static int stbi__stdio_read(void *user, char *data, int size)
{
   return (int) fread(data,1,size,(FILE*) user);
}

static void stbi__stdio_skip(void *user, int n)
{
   int ch;
   fseek((FILE*) user, n, SEEK_CUR);
   ch = fgetc((FILE*) user);  /* have to read a byte to reset feof()'s flag */
   if (ch != EOF) {
      ungetc(ch, (FILE *) user);  /* push byte back onto stream if valid. */
   }
}

static int stbi__stdio_eof(void *user)
{
   return feof((FILE*) user) || ferror((FILE *) user);
}

static stbi_io_callbacks stbi__stdio_callbacks =
{
   stbi__stdio_read,
   stbi__stdio_skip,
   stbi__stdio_eof,
};

static void stbi__start_file(stbi__context *s, FILE *f)
{
   stbi__start_callbacks(s, &stbi__stdio_callbacks, (void *) f);
}

#endif // !STBI_NO_STDIO

static void stbi__rewind(stbi__context *s)
{
   // conceptually rewind SHOULD rewind to the beginning of the stream,
   // but we just rewind to the beginning of the initial buffer, because
   // we only use it after doing 'test', which only ever looks at at most 92 bytes
   s->img_buffer = s->img_buffer_original;
   s->img_buffer_end = s->img_buffer_original_end;
}

#ifndef STBI_NO_FAILURE_STRINGS
static int stbi__err(const char *str)
{
   stbi__g_failure_reason = str;
   return 0;
}
#endif

static void *stbi__malloc(size_t size)
{
    return STBI_MALLOC(size);
}

// stb_image uses ints pervasively, including for offset calculations.
// therefore the largest decoded image size we can support with the
// current code, even on 64-bit targets, is INT_MAX. this is not a
// significant limitation for the intended use case.
//
// we do, however, need to make sure our size calculations don't
// overflow. hence a few helper functions for size calculations that
// multiply integers together, making sure that they're non-negative
// and no overflow occurs.

// return 1 if the sum is valid, 0 on overflow.
// negative terms are considered invalid.
static int stbi__addsizes_valid(int a, int b)
{
   if (b < 0) return 0;
   // now 0 <= b <= INT_MAX, hence also
   // 0 <= INT_MAX - b <= INTMAX.
   // And "a + b <= INT_MAX" (which might overflow) is the
   // same as a <= INT_MAX - b (no overflow)
   return a <= INT_MAX - b;
}

// returns 1 if the product is valid, 0 on overflow.
// negative factors are considered invalid.
static int stbi__mul2sizes_valid(int a, int b)
{
   if (a < 0 || b < 0) return 0;
   if (b == 0) return 1; // mul-by-0 is always safe
   // portable way to check for no overflows in a*b
   return a <= INT_MAX/b;
}

#if !defined(STBI_NO_JPEG) || !defined(STBI_NO_PNG) || !defined(STBI_NO_TGA) || !defined(STBI_NO_HDR) || !defined(STBI_NO_GIF)
// returns 1 if "a*b + add" has no negative terms/factors and doesn't overflow
static int stbi__mad2sizes_valid(int a, int b, int add)
{
   return stbi__mul2sizes_valid(a, b) && stbi__addsizes_valid(a*b, add);
}
#endif

// returns 1 if "a*b*c + add" has no negative terms/factors and doesn't overflow
static int stbi__mad3sizes_valid(int a, int b, int c, int add)
{
   return stbi__mul2sizes_valid(a, b) && stbi__mul2sizes_valid(a*b, c) &&
      stbi__addsizes_valid(a*b*c, add);
}

// returns 1 if "a*b*c*d + add" has no negative terms/factors and doesn't overflow
static int stbi__mad4sizes_valid(int a, int b, int c, int d, int add)
{
   return stbi__mul2sizes_valid(a, b) && stbi__mul2sizes_valid(a*b, c) &&
      stbi__mul2sizes_valid(a*b*c, d) && stbi__addsizes_valid(a*b*c*d, add);
}

#if !defined(STBI_NO_JPEG) || !defined(STBI_NO_PNG) || !defined(STBI_NO_TGA) || !defined(STBI_NO_HDR) || !defined(STBI_NO_GIF)
// mallocs with size overflow checking
static void *stbi__malloc_mad2(int a, int b, int add)
{
   if (!stbi__mad2sizes_valid(a, b, add)) return NULL;
   return stbi__malloc(a*b + add);
}
#endif

static void *stbi__malloc_mad3(int a, int b, int c, int add)
{
   if (!stbi__mad3sizes_valid(a, b, c, add)) return NULL;
   return stbi__malloc(a*b*c + add);
}

#if !defined(STBI_NO_LINEAR) || !defined(STBI_NO_HDR) || !defined(STBI_NO_PNM) || !defined(STBI_NO_PNG) || !defined(STBI_NO_PSD)
static void *stbi__malloc_mad4(int a, int b, int c, int d, int add)
{
   if (!stbi__mad4sizes_valid(a, b, c, d, add)) return NULL;
   return stbi__malloc(a*b*c*d + add);
}
#endif

#if !defined(STBI_NO_JPEG) || !defined(STBI_NO_GIF)
// returns 1 if the sum of two signed ints is valid (between -2^31 and 2^31-1 inclusive), 0 on overflow.
static int stbi__addints_valid(int a, int b)
{
   if ((a >= 0) != (b >= 0)) return 1; // a and b have different signs, so no overflow
   if (a < 0 && b < 0) return a >= INT_MIN - b; // same as a + b >= INT_MIN; INT_MIN - b cannot overflow since b < 0.
   return a <= INT_MAX - b;
}
#endif

#if !defined(STBI_NO_JPEG)
// returns 1 if the product of two ints fits in a signed short, 0 on overflow.
static int stbi__mul2shorts_valid(int a, int b)
{
   if (b == 0 || b == -1) return 1; // multiplication by 0 is always 0; check for -1 so SHRT_MIN/b doesn't overflow
   if ((a >= 0) == (b >= 0)) return a <= SHRT_MAX/b; // product is positive, so similar to mul2sizes_valid
   if (b < 0) return a <= SHRT_MIN / b; // same as a * b >= SHRT_MIN
   return a >= SHRT_MIN / b;
}
#endif

// stbi__err - error
// stbi__errpf - error returning pointer to float
// stbi__errpuc - error returning pointer to unsigned char

#ifdef STBI_NO_FAILURE_STRINGS
   #define stbi__err(x,y)  0
#elif defined(STBI_FAILURE_USERMSG)
   #define stbi__err(x,y)  stbi__err(y)
#else
   #define stbi__err(x,y)  stbi__err(x)
#endif

#define stbi__errpf(x,y)   ((float *)(size_t) (stbi__err(x,y)?NULL:NULL))
#define stbi__errpuc(x,y)  ((unsigned char *)(size_t) (stbi__err(x,y)?NULL:NULL))

STBIDEF void stbi_image_free(void *retval_from_stbi_load)
{
   STBI_FREE(retval_from_stbi_load);
}
